dkar chag nga'i skyes yul/ spropha ma'i sdun lan gsab ched/lha sa'i jo bor mjal dgos/ 7rma chu la dar lam chags/ sdu3dbyug pa'i mo/ spro6nga rārdo lha sa la slebs/ 22nga rgya gar nas zha ra chags/ 25long ba'i slob grwa 34o tsi snying rje 'a/ 36lha sa shor pa red/ 42zha ra dang lo tsā ba/ 50nga'i 'chang sa gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ 58zha ro yin yango /phan thogs yod/ 647gang sa mchago la gsung bsgyuro/ 67nga rgya gar lha phyags su gnas spar byas/ 79bod la zhe chags/ 83nga'i dge ba'i las ka 87nga'i yi ge gtsags spyad dang bod yig 92zam gdong rin po cher bcar 'dri/ 94dge bshes sangs rgyas la bcar 'dri/ 96dpararis khag 99

sngon gleng /gal srid khyed rang rgya gar lho phyogs kyi mon gho gzhis chags su phebs myong yod tshe/ a khya pad ma zhes pa'i mi 'di yang khyed kyis mthong thos yod srid/ gzhis chags der khong ni mi grags can zhig red/ phran rang gis 1rtseshaṃ7 lo nas 100rngulo'i bar dga' byang grwa tshang du thos bsam slob gnyer byed skabs/ a khya pad ma dang 'ablel 'dris byung la/ dus de nas bzung khong ni nga'i sems nas yal thabs med par gyur/zhwa mo gor dbyibs can zhig gi 'og na mig shel nag po/ gzugs po mi ring mi thung zhing / sha mdangs rgyas la dar ba/ lag pa g.yon pas phreng ba 'dren pa dang /lag pa g.yas pas lag rten g.yugs shing lam sna 'amāme/ lag rten de ni khong gi mig gi tshab yin la/ grong sde gsum pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi gdan sa khag la rang nyid gcig bur rgyun du 'gro mkhan zhig yod/de ni a khya pad ma red/ngas a khya pad ma dang 'brel 'dris byas pa nas bzung / khong gi lo rgyus dag nga'i sems la ri mo bzhin babs/ khong gi lag pa nas 'jus te lam rgyus byed skabs/ khong gi ngo shes pa ྅65 skad gzengs mthon pos/ a khu pad ma/ gsar 'gyur ga re 'dug ces 'dri/ de nas khos kyang skad gzengs mthon pos gsar

51 a khu pad ma/'gyur bshad cing /a khya pad mas skad gdangs la brtags nas mi su dang su yin pa'i ngo thag chod/ a khu pad mas bshad pa ltar na/ khong gis bi bi si dang woyesi opha a mi ri ka ol in di ya reḍa'o bcas kyi hin skad gsar 'gyur la nyan gyi yod zer la/des khong ni gsar 'gyur gyi yong khyangs zhig chags pa red/nged kyi grogs po kha shas kyis nga la/ khyed kyis ci'i phyir a khya pad ma'i lo rgyus 'bri gi yod/ a khu pad ma la lo rgyus ga re yod pa red/ ces dris myong /ngas da bar du dri ba de la lan btab med/ de'i lan ni 'di lta ste/ a khya pad ma ni lo tsā ba zhig yin/ a khu pad mas long ba'i gtsags yig thog hin di'i skad 'bri klog thub kyi yod/ a khya pad ma ni bod yig long ba'i gtsags yig tu 'bri mkhan phal cher thog ma de yin/ a khu pad mas 'jon tshod kyis bod mi tsho+os hin skad mi shes pa'i skabs su skad bsgyur gyi zhabs zhu zhus/ 'on kyang khong la thob dang go sa gtan nas ma thob/khong gis skad bsgyur gyi rin yang blangs ma myong zer/a khu pad mas mi tshe gcig la mig shes yod pa dang mig shes med pa'i skye ba gnyis blangs/a khu pad mas bod rang btsan yin pa'i skabs dang shor ba'i skabs gnyis ka'i nango mi tshe bskyal/'di ltar bsams tshe ngas a khya pad ma'i mi tshe rin thang yod par 'dad da//a khu pad ma'i lo rgyus nang khong gis skad bsgyur byas pa'i tshul de khyangs skyel bya dgos pa ni nga la gal chen por gyur/ khos skad bsgyur gyi zhabs zhu yul gyi khongs su kun bde gling dza sag kyang yod zer༈/ ngas don de brtsad gcod byed slad

sngon gleng / 511 kun bde gling gi mi che'i lo rgyus las 'phros pa'i gtam thabs byus snying stobs kyi 'bras bu zhes pa'i pod gnyis de nyos pa yin/ deb 'di'i nang a khya pad mas khong la skad bsgyur byas rigs ma 'khod mod/ deb dang po'i shog ngos 34rngo par tshig 'di 'dra zhig 'khod yod/ lhag par dbyin hin skad yig ye nas mi shes pa'i nag khyang nag rkyang las ka mang che skad bsgyur kho nar bsten dgos mun nag sbar 'tshol cha rkyen dang dmigs yul ri zor ga 'dzol rang stobs kyi zhus pa de 'dra zhig las med kyang lhag bsam sems shugs kyi go cha gyon te lkugs pa a tshugs kyis phu rgyugs mda' rgyugs bya dgos stabs skabs re pha rol rogs ram gyi re ltos zhu yul dang / skabs re mnyam 'khrid skad bsgyur nga gnyis bar la ngas dbyin ji ma shes/ khos bod skad yag po ma shes pa'i skabs su phan tshun bsun snang mthong chung gis snang tshul 'dra min byung ba'i skabs 'gar blo pham gyis rang gis rang la dus skabs kyi dran gso dang / sems gso byed dgos pa'ang yang yong gi yod/ ces 'khod 'dug gong gsal gyi tshig phreng ring po dag gi nang don ci yin cha ma 'tshal mod/ khong dang skad bsgyur ba la dwags pa'am kar shā pa sogs kyi bar go brda legs po ma 'phrod pa'i tshul zhig gsal la/ de ltar na khong gis a khya pad ma la re bcol byas yod srid pa zhig red/ 'on kyang mig med cig skad bsgyur la 'khrid pa de lo rgyus su 'god 'dod med pa yin nam gang ltar 'di'i skor gong gsal gyi deb nang yod pa nga'i mig lam du ma yong la/ ma su ri'i 'o ma las rda ram sa la'i chu zhim zer ba'i gtam de yang khong gis zhal bzhes gnang mi 'dug go/

sto1 1 1 55 khu pad ma/yig thog nas ngas a khya pad ma skad bsgyur ba yin pa'i khyangs skyel ma rnyed na'ang / don 'di par gyi thog nas mngon sum gyis ra 'phrod pa 'dug pa 'dir 'khod pa'i par rigs la gzigs dang gsal lo//da ni deb chung 'di'i byung rim cung zad bsnyad par bya ste/ de yang phyi lo 2༷༷༷lo'i lo gsar skabs su nged mon gho gzhis chags su bskyod pa'i skabs dang bsdun nas ngas a khya pad ma'i mi che'i lo rgyus sgra phab 'khor lor bcug de nas yun ring zhig 'gor/ mtshams zhig nged kyi sgra phab 'khor thag de dag kyang mi rnyed par gyur/ yang bskyar nged kyi chos grogs bstan 'dzin skal ldan lags dang dge 'dun legs bshad gnyis brgyud nas bcar 'dri lan gnyis zhus/ bcar 'dri de dag bcar 'dri'i ngo bor lus/ snga lor de dag rim gyis yi ger phab skabs bod kyi dus bab gsar khang gi dge 'dun rgya mtshos rogs ram gnang /'on kyang nga'i khor yug 'di'i nang dpe deb 'bri ba'i mthun rkyen ha cang dkon/rang gi ham sems kyis las ka 'di'i sne la 'jus kyang / rang gi le lo des rang nyid brnyan 'phrin la btags/ mu mthud nas nar 'gyangs su song / las ka 'di'i thog la dus codi nyung ngu zhig las gtong ma thub/ 2༷༷4 lor nged kyis 5yotshugs kyis 'bad pa byas pa'i 'bras bur da cha gzhi nas deb chung 'di yang 'khyungs par gyur/

sngon theng / grathog ma'i 'char gzhi la nged kyis bod nas yig cha 'tshol sgrab sogs brgyud nas a khu pad ma'i mi che'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs cung rgyas spro zhig 'bri 'dun gyis 'bad 'bungs byas mod/ yig cha khag gcig ma 'byor zhing / 'byor ba'i khongs nas nga la dgos pa'i gsal cha rigs mi 'dug brten/ 'dir 'khod kyi rgyab ljongs mdor bsdus de las bris pa med cing / bskyar du bsams skabs de ni phyo+ogs gcig nas dge bar mthong ste/a khu pad ma'i mi tshe ma sgrib par 'dug pas sa/rgyu cha 'tshol ba dang zhu dag gi las rim khrod/ la rtse deng rabs bod kyi rig gzhung dpe mdzod khang gi dbu 'dzin sku zhabs pad ma 'bum lags dang / dpe mdzod khang / bod kyi dus bab rtsom sgrig pa dge 'dun lhag bsam/ in ḍi ya na mtho slob kyi dge rgan isaloṭa si par ling dang g.yang 'bum rgyal/ nged kyi chos grogs dga' lngan du bzhugs pa zlos rogs ram gnang bar thugs rje che zhu/ a ma me re piṭar son nas kyang a khya pad ma'i 'dra par len pa'i rogs gnang bar thugs rje che zhu la/ bod kyi dus bab gsar khang gis jus 'god dang par du btab pa/ wa zhin ṭon du rten gzhi byas pa'i rgyal spyi'i bod don las 'gul khang nas stu04dzi11ba5sasku(0smo11 6khusgyuzhes pa'i rogs dngul gnang bar yang thugs rje che zhu ba yin/ khyed cag gi brtse ba'i rogs ram dang bral tshe nged kyi deb chung 'di yang da dung rmi lam gyi ri mo zhig las ma 'das pa gor ma chag lags/

5 55 khya pad ma/phan thogs min la ma ltos par nged kyis mi yul 'dir deb chung kha shas 'bri khul byas zhing / de dag gi dge ba bsngo ba sogs kyang bod rang gi sngar lugs su byas pa yin/ 'on kyang thengs 'dir nga'i sems nas thugs rje che zhes shor sa zhig ni bza' zla tshe ring dbyangs skyed dang / bu mo tshe dpal dang kun lha bcas yin/bza' zlas a khya pad ma'i deb 'di gang myur tshar ba byos zhes yang yang skul thogade'i ched byis pa gnyis phyi rol du 'khrid nas nged la khya sim sim gyi khor yug lan gcig mi/na par bsgrun pa lags/de ltar deb yo 'di grub cing /da ni nged kyi smon pa'i tshig 'di ltar smra ste/ma bcol las 'dir dang ba bdag gis byas//mi 'dod btsan gyis bkol ba gang yang med//ma dgos lci ba'i las tshags bdag gir byas//mi 'grub sems khral lci mos yun jing mnar//grub pa 'dir yang dge ba nyung zhig mchis//skyon dang ma dag chogs kyis yongs su bzung //'ga' zhig shes mod bca' ba'i blo ma lang //'ga' zhig mi shes bzhin du de mur lus//

sngon gleng / khu a la bod skad 'di yang ya mtshar te//yi ger bstun na bod mis mi go la//skad dang bstun na yi ger mi mthun stabs//phran nyid gcig pur nongs pa'i rgyu ma mchis//'di ltar bris pa'i dge ba'i sa bon ni//skra rtses blangs pa'i chu thigs tsam mchis na//a khya pad mas gathe1 byas bod rigs rnams//rang dbang zhi bde'i dpal la sbyod par smon//2༷༷7phyi zla 1tshes 1༷la/dge 'dun rab gsal gyis hris pa'o//

nga'i skyes yul/a khya pad ma skyes pa'i lo ste 1rtse27 yas mas su reb gong khul la reb gong nang so dang zhar skal lngan rgya mtsho sku phreng rim byon gyis chab srid kyi mnga' dbang bsgyur yod/ 'on kyang skabs mang por rgya dmag gi btsan gnon phog yod la/ lhag par mā pu'u h+phang gi skabs su 'jigs su rung ba'i dmag sde slebs nas reb gong rong 'brog gi yul sde mang po bcom/ skyes pa mang po bsad/ grong sde mang po me la sreg pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang /1lnga2༷ lor go min tang gi dmag sde zi ling mkhar du yod pa tshos mdo smad mgo log khyal du btsan gnon byas nying / lo 'di'i yas mas su mgo log gi mi drag mang po 'dzin bzung dang / rgyu dngos 'asdo+og bcom sogs byas rkyen lo ngo bcu phrag gnyis lhag ring rgya bod bar gyi dmag 'khrug zhol 'jags su song med/ go min tang gi dmag dbung 'di dag gis rim gyis mdo smad bla brang khul dang / de bzhin snang ra khyal/ de nas reb gong phyogs su dmag drangs/ 133rngu lor reb gong gi 'phrang yar nang zhes pa'i grong sde khag la dmag drangs nas grong sde 24lhag mer bsregs byas/ 'phratsung yar nang gi dar zhing dgon pa yang spe la sreg

2 lug khu pad ma/reb gong gi chab srid dbang 'dzin pa rong bo'i nang so dang rgya bo'i dpon po/ shar bla brang gi phyag mdzod gsum yang khrom 'dus su ske bregs te bsad/ 1lnga3rtse lo nas lo grangs kha zhas ring reb gong blon che sogs su dmag drangs te bsad 'phrog bcom pa'i las ngan byas/skabs 'di'i bod kyi byus nyes zhig ni/ rgya dmag gis reb gong khyal gyi glong sde kha shas bsad bcom byas na yang grong sde gzhan snus de la rgyab skyor gyi rnam pa ye nas thon med la/ reb gong khul nas bla brang phyogs la skyabs bcol la 'gro ba dang / de nas sa gnas gzhan la skyabs bcol la 'gro ba sogs kyis khyangs 'khyol thabs byas pa de red/ 'on kyang grong sde'i khrod kyi gnod pa ma phog pa ཿme zhing 'brog gi rgyun las dang chos kyi byed sgo khag la brel bzhin mchis/ rtsom pa pos bris pa'i mchan/nga'i ming la pad ma 'bum zer/ bod mi snus nga la a khya pad ma zer/ nga 1rtse27 bod shing glang lo la skyes/ nga skyes pa'i yul ni reb gong red/ reb gong smad pa lha khang sde ba'i ban rgan tshang zer ba de red/ nga snu'i smad pa sde bdun gyi nang bon po dang rnying ma/ dge lugs bcas chos lugs khag gsum yod/ mi tshang gcig yin na yang de'i nang bon po dang rnying ma/ dge lugs bcas yod/ pha bon po yin na yang bu dge lugs pa'i dgon pa'i grwa pa byed/ rnying ma'i bu yang dge lugs pa'i grwa ba byed/ 'di dag la chos lugs kyi phyogs ris kyang yod pa ma red/ nga'i nang khyim de yang mi thog mang po'i ring gi khyim tshang zhig red/ de'i

nga'i skyes yul/ 3rtags mtshan de la nged tshang gi sgo khar sdong po chen po zhig yod/ lo mang po'i ring gi sdong rgan zhig red/nga'i a pha'i ming la snying dkar rgyal zer/ nga'i a ma'i ming la 'abhug mo tshe ring zer/ nga tsho spun brgyad yod/ nga las che ba spun bzhi dang nga las chung ba gsum yod/ rim pa bzhin/ sha bo rgya maces/ pad ma tshe brtan/ pad ma 'tsho/ de nas nga rang pad ma 'bum/ sha bo tshe brtan/ pad ma bkra zhis/ mkhar mo byams bcas dang / yang rdo rje tshe brtan zhu ba de chung dus nas ma 'tshams pa red/ nga tsho ni zhing pa'i khyim tshang zhig yin/1rtse32 tsam la nga lo drug bdun zhig la slebs dus/ nga spen dkar thang dgon pa'i grwa ba byas/ nga'i grwa pa'i ming la dge 'dun rgya mtsho zer/ nga dgon pa der lo ngo kha shas kyi ring bsdad pa yin/ 1034 lor nga lo dgu tsam la slebs skabs rong bo dgon pa'i chos sgor zhugs te lo gsum la bsnad pa yin/ de ni ngas chos kyi gzhung la slob sbyong byed thub pa'i re ba red/ yin na yang nga la dge rgan yag po zhig ma thob pa dang / de bzhin ngas slob sbyong yang de tsam byed ma thub par brten slar yang sben dkar thang dgon par log pa yin/ de nas lo bcu dgu dang nyi shu tsam la ma slebs bar du nga rang dgon pa de la bsnad pa yin/ reb gong khyal gyi chos phyogs kyi byed sgo zhig la/ rong bo dgon chen gyi grwa pa

4 55 khu pad ma/rnams ston chos zhes spen dkar thang dgon pa la yong gi red/ 'di lo re re bzhin gyi ston khar yod pa'i chos phyogs kyi lam srol zhig red/ de dus rong bo dgon chen gyi grwa pa rnams nyin bdun tsam la bzhugs kyi red/ smad pa sde bdun gyis nyin re bzhin dge 'dun pa la bsten bkur byed kyi red/ de dus 'grul bzhud kyi mthun rkyen legs po zhig med stabs/ nga snu'i sde ba rnams kyis rta drel ded nas dge 'dun pa'i ca dngos rnams phar skyel tshur len byed dgos kyi yod/ bod zla lngatshes 22 nyin grwa tshang gser khri phebs nas smad pa sde bdun gyi mi mang rnams la dbang gnang gi red/ de nas ston chos grol 'gro gi red/spen dkar thang dgon pa la rten rtsa chen zhig yod pa ni rje du kha ma red/ 'di'i lo rgyus mdor tsam bzhad na/ rje rin po che sku dngos bzhugs dus su nyin gcig la dbu skra lan bdun bsil nas lan re la sku re bzhengs/ sku mtha' ma de skam slad me la sros stabs/ sku yis/ ‘‘du ba kha gi 'dug’’ ces gsung 'byon stabs/rje du kha ma zhes grags pa red/ rten 'di nyid byang rtse mkhan po zhig gis dbus nas gdan drangs nas spen dkar thang dgon par bzhugs bcug pa 'di reb gong khyal gyi rten rtsa che shos zhig red/ reb gong stod smad kyi rong 'brog gnyis ka rten 'di la mjal slad yong gi red/ dgon pa'i srung ma gatherte bo yang dam can chos rgyal red/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan yang rje rin po che'i srung ma dam can chos rgyal yin pa dang / rje du kha ma nga tsho'i rten gyi gasto bo yin pa'i dbang gis red/ nga tsho'i dgon pa 'di chos rje don grub rin chen gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon rnying zhig red ces mdo

nga'i skyes yul/ 5smad chos 'byung du yang 'khod 'dug zer/nga snu'i spen dkar thang dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams mtsho sngon po sogs la grong chog la ma song na/ yong sgo sogs med pas dgon pa'i 'asturdo rten gang yang yod pa ma red/ der brten nga yang mtsho sngon por song ba yin/ mtsho sngon po'i stong skor la slebs nas mar rkang tsha la 'gro dgos bsams nas ri bo nyi zla nas tshur yong skabs/ nga bya khyung gi grwa pa gcig la thug grwa ba de dang nga gnyis mtsho sngon por macan skor la song nas mtsho mgo bar du mnyam du yong ba yin/ kho sgo me chab cha la 'gro gi yin zer/ khong la 7rgyal ba rin po che'i par zhig 'dug de dus nga thos 7rgyal ba rin po che zhes go myong ba ma gtogs mjal myong yod pa ma red/ par de khong dgung lo lnga yin dus kyi khog stod la sog rtses brgyab pa dang dbu la jo zhwa mnabs bsdad pa/ sku sha rgyag pa/ rāni khra med pa zhig 'dug par de khos nga la sbrad song / nga rang yang dga' bo byung / par de nga rang lha sa dang lha sa nas rgya gar la slebs rag bar du bdag nyar byas pa yin/ de nas nga dang nga'i spun nye zhig yod pa mnyam du mtsho sngon po'i rkang tsha zer ba'i sa cha de la grong chog la song ba yin/der ngas zla ngo mang po la chos bklags nas bsdad pa yin/ mtsho sngon po'i sa cha 'dir 'brog pa rnams kyis sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed par brten/ ri dwags dgo dang rkyang sogs kyang nor lug dang 'dres nas sdod kyi yod/nga mtsho sngon por yod pa'i skabs der ha sa kha pa zer ba'i mi mang po zhig slebs song / deng sang bsam blo btang na/ mi de tsho ni shin cang phyogs nas red/

6 lug khu pad ma/nga tshos thog mar rgya gung khran zer ba'i dmag mi yod pa red ces thos myong ba de tsho yin rgyu red bsams/ phan tshun bar go brda mi 'brod mod/ khong therto la rnam 'gyur bstan nathe//‘‘khyed zlos mi gsod kyi yod dam/’’ zhes dris dus/ khong tshos/‘‘nga tshos mi gsod kyi med/’’ ces zer/ de nas khong tsho mi gsod mkhan min pa dang / khong tsoyang lung pa shor nas yong ba'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug khong tshor nga tshos sha rigs sbrad pa de khong tsho kha che yin stabs za gi mi 'dug gzhan za 'azung gang yin yang za gi 'dug khong tsho yong nas rim gyis sa phyogs 'dir gzhis chags pa dang / de nas ri dwags rngon pa'i las ka byas/ shā ba dang rkyang sogs la me mda' brgyab nas bsad/ de yang me mda' phog pa'i sems can gyi srog ma chad pa'i sngon la ske bregs nas bsad pa'i sha de khong snus za gi 'dugaphyis su kha che'i rigs 'di tsho skyabs bcol la yong ba'i go brda yag po ma 'phrod par brten rim gyis khong tsho lha sa'i phyogs la 'gro bcug pa red/ de nas khong tsho rim gyis rgya gar ka'ismir khul la slebs 'dug deng sang bsam blo btang na khong tsho yang rgya gung khran las thar ched skyabs bcol yong ba yin pa gzhi nas shes kyi 'dug

pha ma'i drin 'dun gatra/ba ched/lha sa'i jo bor mjal dgos/da ni nga yang los nas nyi shu la slebs 'dugaphyi lo 1gyi4catsam red/nga tho'i kha rgyun ༷/pha ma' dran lan ga/// ched//lhasa'i jo bo la sdujal dgos//zhes zer srol zhag yod pa red/nga pha yul du skya bo rnams kya khongs nas dbus la 'gro mkhan nyung nyung yinasle/gang yin zer na/lam kha thag tram̐ng khar ṭ+wāṃ ngo mang por gom slebagrod byed sledagos kya sdu+od/tram̐n dkaX thang dgon pa' grwa ba nga' grogs po rang nyad zer 'ib zhag yod/nyan gcag khong gas nga la/jidi ba/nyathag zhwa/ thegashādi khurdobo/ོ //shādi/'jurngadithag/ spyorang gnyis kyis lam mgo na gya ma red/ ces bshad pa yan/ngas sngon la yang lha sar 'gro ba'i thabs shes sdu shas byas pa yin mod nang mis bzung nas 'gro ru bcuX ma song /de nas khong gas/shes 'i slekhyed kyas sula'angamabashad/rong ba/ tshunang ga grwa ba kha shas 'gro ga 'dugang gcis kyang rong bo dgon par song nas khong dang mnyam du skad cha bshad de 'grokhong tsho rogs pa yag po red/ ces bshad byung /

20 6ltakhu pad ma/tshang re rer song nas nga thos rang gi ltogs yus kyi lo rgyus re bshad/ khong tshos zho dang rtsam pa ster/ nyin gcig la nga thos rtsam pa thengs bdun tsam zas 'dugade nas 'brog pa stu lam ston byas pa ltar/ nga tsordza dmar mo nang zer ba de la song / de la dred mong yod pa red zer mod nga tsho dred mong la thug ma byung / nyin gsum tsam gyi ring la song skabs rdo la bka' 'gyur brkos yod zer ba'i rdo yi bka' 'gyur gyi sa gcig la slebs song / 'di 'dra bod chol kha gsum gyi khongs la yod pa ma red zer/ nga tshos ri de la bskor ba byas te rim gyis rdza chu brgal nas rdza skya dgon pa zer ba'i dgon pa zhig la slebs/ de nas nyin gcig gi lam nas nga tsho rdza skye dgu dgon pa la slebs/ de dus nga tso'i rogs pa gcig gi rkang par khyis so brgyab nas nga tsho mu mthud 'gro ma thub par lus/ skabs der dgon pa de'i grwa pa gcig gis dgon pa'i khrims 'gal byas stabs khong la dar lcag lnga brgya gzhu rgyu'i chad pa phog yod stabs/ grwa pa de nga snu'i sar slebs nas/‘6khyed tshos snugame chen zhal ngo la re skul zhus na/ nga'i chad pa gu yangs su 'gro rgyu yin pa dang / de ltar byung tshe ngas khyed snung rtsam pa dang zas rigs ster/’’ces zer/ nga tshos kyang khas len byas nas tshogis chen zhal ngo la zhu bar song / rdza skye dgu'i dgon pa 'di dgon pa chen po zhig red/ grwa pa ༄0gis la 'tshogs pa'i gral rnga der tshogs chen zhal ngo gnyis bzhugs 'dug nga tsos khab dang zhing mngar gyi 'bul ba phul nas nyes pa gya yangs yong ba'i re ba zhus/ thogs chen zhal ngo gnyis kyis/

dbyug pa'i mo/ 21‘‘grwa pa kho sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo red/’’ sogs tshogs gtam ring po zhig gtong gi 'dug nga ཿsi yar zhu yang yang zhus stabs nyes chad kyi dar lcag lnga brgya de dar lcag lnga bcu tham pa bar bcag song / khos kyang nga snung rtsam pa cung zad re byin/ de ltar nga tshos ngal gso ba dang rogs pa'i rma kha sos ched bsdad pa yin/ rdza skye rgu dgon pa'i grwa pa gicig gis bshad srol ltar na/ nga tsho nyin grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga song na lha sa la slebs kyi red zer/ nga tsho yang 'gro mgo btsugs/ zhi ba'i khog zer ba'i sa cha zhig brgyud nas yong / de'i mdo la slebs skabs nga tsho 'bri chu la thug 'gag la zhes pa'i la zhig brgyab nas song / la 'di la mthon po zhig red/ sa cha 'di'i g.yas g.yon na rdo yi ma ṇi brkos pa de 'dra mang po dang 'phrad kyi 'dug khams nang chen zhes pa brgyud nas yong pa yin/ mthar nga tsho sog tsan dan dgon pa la slebs/ nag chu kha la slebs nas nga tshonyi ma kha shas la bsdad pa yin/ 'di nas nga snus lha sa'i skor la skad cha mang po go gi 'dug

nga 'odro+o lha zla/ 'a/ slebazla//a khu pad ma 1lnga47 lor lha sar 'byor/ lo 'dir rgya gar la rang btsan thob cing / rgya nag nang gung khran tang gis rgya nag yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i phyogs su 'gro bzhin yod/ bod nang du 7gong sa mchog dgung na phra zhing /rgyal tshab stag brag phyogs kyis rgyal tshab zur pa dwa sgreng 'ju bzung byas pa sogs lha sa'i nang gi bod kyi chab srid de lhing 'jags shig med/ zhwa sgab pa'i srid don rgyal rabs pod gnyis pa'i shog grangs 3rngurngu par 1lnga47 lo'i bod zla 2 pa'i nang rgyal zur dwa sgreng 'ju bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul 'khod 'dug stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis kyis brtsams pa'i mi che'i byung ba brjod pa'i nang gnas tshul 'di dag kha gsal 'khod la/ khong gis/ phyi lo 1lnga47 zla 3tshes 2rngu nyin srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che glo bur du batshoni khang nang sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa red ces grags/ zhes 'khod/ rtsom pa pos bris pa'i mchan/lha sar slebs khar rwa sgreng dgon par dang por slebs kyi 'dug phyi lo 1rtse47tsam yin pa red/ nga tsho rgyal bo rwa sgreng la mjal du 'gro dus khong tshang kha sang sde ba gzhung gis bzung song ba red zer/ lha sar khrid song ba red zer/ nga tsho dwa sgreng

nga tsho lha sa la slebs/ 23dgon par mjal te nga tsho mkhan po'i nang la song ba yin/‘‘mgo ril ril thams cad gsod cig ces sde ba gzhung gis bka' btang yod pa red/ khyed tsho yar mar la 'gro rung gi ma red/ gsod kyi red da/’’ ces grong gseb pa de tshos nga tshor bshad kyi 'dug lha sar dmag rgyag gi yod pa red/de nas nga tsho 'phan po'i nang brgyud nas lha sar slebs skabs gnyis pa'i tshogis mchod kyi kha thug de 'dra zhig red/ nga lho'i nang 'bras spungs la 'gro mkhan gyi grwa ba kha shas yod rung / khong tsho 'bras spungs la 'gro ma thub par nga tsho mi bdun de dga' lngan la slebs/ nyin shas ring nga tsho grwa ba'i nang la bskungs nas bsdad/ bdun phrag gcig tsam min rung de 'dra cig la lha sa'i jo bo la mgyogs por ma mjal na nga co'i rtsam pa sogs med pas mgyogs por lha sa'i jo bo la mjal ba yin/ 'di nas bzung nga tsho dbyas rogs pa rnams kha 'thor ba red/ dpe cha blta mkhan de tshosi dbe cha bltas/ 'bras spungs la 'gro ma thub pa red/ kha shas lo gcig gi smon lam la sgug nas mtshams mtshams la dga' ldan la yong /mtshams mtshams la glong gseb de 'dra la song / nga lha sa'i jo bo mjal dus khrom na rgyal po rwa sgreng bcom pa'i ca lag mang po mthong rgyu 'dugade nas nga yar klung 'od dkar khog dang rje rin po che'i gnas de tsho tshang mar gnas skor la song ba yin/ lha mo'i bla mtsho thag nye bo 'dug pas der mjal du phyin pa yin/ mtsho 'di las gnas mjal ba kha zhas la pha yul gyi snang brnyan ston

24 a khu pad ma/gyi yod pa dang kha shas la lung bstan sogs sna snugs ston gyi yod pa red/ nga der mtsho mjal la song nas nyino gnyis la gzab gozab byas nas bltas pa yin mod nga la gang yang bstan ma sang / 'ad dkar khag nas yang bskyar lha sar sang /skabs der lha sa'i smon lam chen mo 'tshogs bsnad yod pas nga yang smon lam la bsdad pa yin/ de nas sgor mo kha shas yod pa de 'khyer nas gzhis ka rtser yong ste snu'i zog nyos te rgya gar la yong / ce'i phan tshun brgyab/ mtshams mtshams la swātshur yag po yod pa lta bu/ mtshams mtshams la yag po med pa lta bu/ de 'dra zhig gi ngang nas nga'i snung la lam lhung ma byung ba red/nga lha sar yod pa'i skabs der ldi tsha a lags zer ba zhig bod gzhung gis batshon khang la bcug yod red zer/ rjes su go dus de dge 'dun chos 'phel tshang red zer/ yin na yang / nga tsos khong gi skor gyi gnas tshul cha tshang zhig lha sar yod skabs shes kyi yod pa ma red/

nga lang bar gyur/a khya pad ma rang lo 2ca tsam la slebs skabs khong rgya gar la slebs/ 1lnga43lor rgya nag tu gung khran gyi gzhung btsugs la/ de ma thag bod du dmag 'jug byas/ chab mdo rgya lag tu shor/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zer ba'i yig cha der 1gyi71 lo'i zla ba 7 pa'i nang ming rtags bkod pa red/ rtsom pa pos bris pa'i mchan/phyi lo 1⑫71 yas mas zhig la/ nga thog mar rgya gar gyi bka' blon sbug (5tshi/1790batha) ces pa'i sa gnas la slebs pa red/ de nas ngas phin sogs ca lag tsag tsig nyos/ de bod du 'khyer nas snung byed kyi yod/ 'di'i sngon la ngas gzhis ka rtse dang rgyal rtse sogs la song nas lo kha shas zhig la thong brgyab nas bsdad pa yin/ de dus nga grwa pa yang log pa red/ de nas rgyal rtse nas skyes dman gcig btsal pa yin/ phun tshogs zer ba'i bu yo zhig red/ snung de lam 'gro ma rgyugs tsang nga'i rogs pa tshang mas rgya gar la song na yag sa red zer/ de nas nga tsho rgya gar la yong pa yin/ bka' blon sbug la slebs dus der khungs ma 'okhyol ba'i grwa ba ldom po dang / 'khyam po mang po yod pa/ nga rārdo tshang ma rdo rje gdan la

26 55 khu pad ma/gnas skor la 'gro zhes nga rdo rje gdan la yong ba yin/ der sim la (sdusmo1a/'i)nas yong ba'i a mdo bsang khog gi mi zhig la zug song / khos/‘‘pad ma/ nga therto sim la la 'gro der las ka bya rgyu yod pa red/ gla cha chen po yod pa red/’’ zer/ nga la sgor mo'i dka' ngal 'phrad bzhin par brten/ kho'i kha la nyan te rgya gar byang phyogs kyi sim la zhes pa'i sa der song ba yin/sim la la slebs te las ka byed skabs/ mi rer sgor gsum re rag gi yod pa red/ lam bakhro'i las ka red/ nga rang mi'i kha la nyan rgyur dga' bo yod/ nyin gcig mi gcig gis sgor gsum dang a no a na zhes pa ni rgya gar gyi sgor zur gyi ming ste (de dang skar ma 27 do mnyam pa yin/)bzhi sbrod gi yin/ nga'i mnyam tu shog zer/ der song nas nyin gnyis gsum zhig gi ring la las ka byas pa yin/nyin gcig nga lho'i lam bzo sa der/ brag rdo gtor byed kyi bgad dzos zhig la me sgron yod/ yin na yang / bgad rdzas de 'thor ma song / nga māme yud tsam la sgug pa yin/ de nas nga dpa' bo'i gras su zhugs te/ bgad rdzas 'jog sa'i nye 'khris la bcar nas me 'bar gyin yod med rtog zhib byas pa yin/ mtshams der bgad rdzas 'thor pa red/ nga dran pa 'thor/ phal cher skar ma bcu grangs zhig la nga brgyal yod pa red/ nga dran pa sos dus/ nga'i las rogs tsos nga'i mtha' bskor yod pa snung mod/ nga'i gdong yongs su rdzogs par rma dang skrangs thebs te dmar lham lham byed kyi 'dug nga'i mig gnyis cha zhar song ba red/ las ka yang nyin drug ring ma gtogs byas yod pa ma red/ a mdo kha sh-is yod pa des

nga long bar gyur/ 27rogs pa byas nas sim la sman khang nang bskyal/rjes su nga'i gdong la phog pa'i ma kha drag tshar ba'i skabs la nga'i mig gnyis kyis mthong gi mi 'dug de nas nga tsho'i gling rgya'i rgad po dge 'dun bstan 'dzin zer ba/ bu phrug gnyis gsum yod pa cig yod/ kho rang las ka la zhe drag dga' bo med stabs/ 'therdo ba'i cha rkyen yang yag po yod pa ma red/ kho rang gi skyes dman de rgya gre/ra khams pa red/ rgya gar gyi skad mkhas po yod pa red/ kho tshang gis nga la bdag po brgyab nas sman khang la 'khrid/ a ri'i sman khang zhig yod pa red/ der yang 'khrid nas song / sman pas brtag dbyad byas rjes/‘‘da lta nga tsos mig bzo thub kyi mi 'dug rjes ma'i dbyar kha shar dus khyed rang zhog dang / nga tsos mig bzo thub min la lta rgyu yin/’mi zhes bshad song / de nas nga tsho rgya nang thur la phyin pa yin/ bhom bhe (207khyi'ismo)zhes pa'i grong khyer de la rogs pa zhig khrid nas phyin pa yin/ der nga tsho a mdo ba khag cig 'dug der bud med mang po zhig 'dug kho tshos nga'i gnas stangs mthong nas sems skyo ba 'dra/ nga la/‘6snying rje/ khyed rang sman khang la bstan na drag gi red/’’ ces bshad nas smarna khang la za ma bskyal rgyu sogs kyi 'aglo song yod na/ nga ce45 sgor mo bsdu gsog gis gtong gi yin/ sman khang la ston rgyu de khyed rang gis 'gan khyer ces bshad /de nas sman khang mang po dang sman pa drag tshad tshang mar bstan pa yin/ yin na yang sman pa tshang ma kha gcig grag red/

28 55 khu bad ma/‘‘khyed rang gi mig bzo thub pa mi 'dugazi’ zer/ ngas tshe 'di mig med pa'i mi+o zhig byed dgos byung song snyam nas sems khral byas shing sems pa thin tu skyo sang /bhom snye rgya masnu'i kha na yod pa red/ sems pa zhe drag skyo nas phyi nyin der ngas rogs pa der/‘‘de ring nged gnyis kyis rgya masnu'i kha la ltad mo blta/ gzugs po zhig bkrus/ de nas nged gnyis log 'gro/’’ zhes bshad nas song ba yin/ song dus rgya marā'i kha la slebs khar rdo skas ring po/ rdo pha bong chen po de 'drar lcags thag yod pa der lag pa 'jus nas chu nang la brgal ba yin/ mtshams de la nga rang gi batha/ma par/‘‘da nga zhi na dga' gi red/ mtsho 'di'i nang la phar khyar song na yag po 'dug’’ ces bsam blor 'khor song yang / de nga'i rogs pa bshad kyi yod pa ma red/ rgya marā'i nang mar brgal song dus/‘6rang srog rang gis bcad na skye ba phyi ma de la mi lus 1phab pa yod pa ma red/’’ ces bshad srol zhig yod pa dran/ yang bsam blo gsar pa zhig 'khor byung / ‘6rang gis myangs dgos rung / tshe 'dir myangs na dga' gi red ma gtogs rang srog rang gis bcad na yag po mi 'dug’’ de ltar nga shi zub ma song /

nga long bar gyur/ 29phyi nyin der nged gnyis phyir sim lar phyin pa yin/ der a ri'i sman khang der song nas lo kha shas bsdad pa red/ mig bzo rgyu ma byung ba red/ nyi ma gcig sman pa sku1nga nas/‘‘pad ma/ da khyed rang la gung gseng sbrad kyi yin/ khyed rang gi mig la na tsha mi 'dug khyed rang la kha lag bskyal mkhan can len du shog ces bshad dgos pa red/ri’ ces zer/nga la ca lag gang yang med la/ rogs pa ces kyang sting rje skyes nas nga la rogs pa byed kyi yod pa red ma gtogs/ khong snus bdag po byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan med/ de ltar bsam blo btang skabs nga sems skyo nas mig chu shor song / de dus nga bsdad sa'i khang pa'i thog khang der a mi ri ka'i bza' tsho gnyis yod/ khong gnyis kyis sman khang du glog gi las ka byed kyi yod pa red/ zhor du nad pa dag gi gzugs por mnyel mnyel byed pa'i sman pa'i las ka yang byed kyi yod/ khong gi ming la ḍibir son (2 5 0'i51 sku30ba)zer/ khong gis thog khang nas nga ngu gi yod pa mthong 'dug de nas khong gnyis nged sar slebs/ skad bsgyur rgya gar pa zhig brgyud nas nga ngu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sdus song / ngas dbyin ji'i skad shes kyi yod ma red/ rgya gar pas khong la/‘‘pad ma sman khang nas 'gro ran pa dang / khong la 'gro sa dang snod sa med la/bdag po yang med stabs ngu gi yod pa red/’’ ces bshad pa red/ de nas khong gnyis kyis nga la pha yul du yi ge btang na len mkhan yod med dris song bar/ngas nga la de 'dra'i nang mi mgo thon pa med ces bshad pa yin/ de mtshams khos

30 55 khu pad ma/nga'i rgyab la byugs byugs shig byas te/‘‘khyed rang gis sems khral ma byed/ khyed rang 'dir bsdad na 'grig gi red/ngas rogs byeng/’’ ces bshad song / nga yang sems dga' byung / nyin rjes ma de la a ri'i mi de yang bskyar yong nas nga'i gon chas rnams g.yugs te khong gi gon chas rnying pa rnams nga la g.yogs byung / de bzhin khong gnyis kyis nga la lo gnyis gsum zhig gi ring la lto gos gnas mal dang bcas pa'i mthun rkyen gnang byung / za ma rigs za khang gcig la mngags nas nyos pa dang / mtshams shig za khang gis zas grang mo bskyal stabs de yang bkag ste khong gnyis kyis gang za ba'i za ma de tsho nga la yang gnang byung / nga gnas skabs shig gi ring la mi chen po'i nyams zhig thon song / gyon chas dang zas rigs tshang ma khong tsodang mnyam bo byas byung / mtha' ma der khong gis thabs shes byas nas sgor mo nyis stong lnga brgya zhig thob byung / ngas sgor mo lnga brgya de nga la rogs pa byed mkhan gyi a mdo mi tshang la sbrad pa yin/ gang yin zer na/ khong gnyis la yang bu gu mang po yod pa dang mi tshang skyo po red/ nyis stong de gnas skabs nga'i sbyin bdag gis nyar song /nyin ma gcig sbyin bdag a ma de nga'i sar yong nas/‘‘nga gnyis rgya gar la lo lnga ma gtogs bsdad mi chog cing / de nas a mi ri ka la log dgos yod/ byas tsang / khyed kyi skor la nga mās bsam blo yang yang btang ba yin/ thabs shes gcig ni/ 'di la mig med pa'i slob grwa gcig yod/khyed rang de la 'asgro gi yin nam/’’ zhes dris byung / ngas lam seng lan btab med/ de mtshams nas a ma des yang bskyar nga la 'di ltar bshad kyi 'dug

nga long bar gyur/ 3spro‘‘khyed rang gis bsam blo thongs dang / slob grwa la 'aglo na khyed rang gis yi ge yang shes kyi red la/ lag shes cung zad cig kyang shes nas las ka tsag tsig byed thub kyi red/ bsam blo thongs/’’ zer/nyin rjes ma der ngas sbyin bdag gnyis la 'di ltar bshad pa yin/‘6nga slob grwa la 'gro gi min/ nga la mig yod dus ngas yi ge ma shes pa red/da mig med dus yi ge shes kyi red bsams kyi mi 'dug’’ces bshad pa yin/de la sbyin bdag pha ma gnyis kyis/‘‘bsam blo de 'dra ma gtong / khyed kyis las rkya/ zhig byed thub song na/ rjes ma khyed la rogs pa byed mkhan yang thob kyi red/’’ ces zer/ngas kyang bsam blo btang ba yin/ yin na yang / ngas yi ge zhig shes kyi red bsams ma song / de dus yang a mdo bza' tshang gnyis yod/ khong gnyis la byis pa kha zhas kyang yod pa red/ yin na yang / khong gnyis bza' tshang kha 'thor song / bud med de gnas skabs ring nga la rogs byed mkhan gyi nang mi tso dang mnyam po bsdad 'dug mtshams mtshams la nged sar yang yong gi yod/nyin gcig ngas mo la/‘6nga gnyis bza' tshang byas na ga 'dra 'dug’ri ces thad tha/ra sdus pa yin/mos lam seng /‘‘'grig gi red/ri’ ces nga la khas len byas byung / da dung mos/

32 6ltakhu pad ma/‘‘ngas khyed dang mnyam du zas kham gang yod kyang mnyam za mnyam 'thung byas te khyed la rogs pa byed kyi yin/’’ zer/ rgyu mtshan 'di tsho sems la bzhag nas ngas sbyin bdag a ma de la bshad pa yin/6‘nga slob grwa la 'gro gi min/ ngas yi be shes rgyu ma red/ de nas 'di la bud med cig yod/ ngas mo dang mnyam bza' tshang byas te sman khang nas phyir thon gi yin/’’ zhes bshad pa yin/ sbyin bdag a ma des/‘‘yag po 'dug’’ ces 'phral du nga la bshad song / yang bskyar bsam blo zhig btang nas bud med de lo ga codi yin min dang 'chang sa brgyab yod med sogs skad cha dris song / ngas bud med de 'chang sa brgyab myong ba ma zad/ byis pa kha shas kyang yod la/ nye char bza' tshang 'thor ba yin pa dang / mo rang lo na sum cu rtsa glangs yin rabs bcas gnas tshul rnams drang por bshad pa yin/skabs der sbyin bdag a ma des/‘‘khyed rang gi 'char gzhi 'di yag po mi 'dug bud med des mig yod mkhan gyi khyo ga g.yugs yod stabs khyod mig ped mkhan gyi khyo ga yang g.yugs nges red/ 'chang sa ma rgyag’’ ces bshad song / ngas kyang legs so zer khyal byas pa yin mod/ semaso nang de la 'thad pa yong gi med/ yang mos mu mthud nas nga la bslab bya byas sang /‘‘khyed rang mig med pa'i slob grwa la songs dang / lo gnyis ma gtogs 'dug dgos pa ma red/ gal srid mo rang dngos gnas khyed la 'dod pa yod na/mos sgug gi red/’mi ces zer/ de bden pa red bsams song / nyin rjes ma der

nga lang bar gyur/ 33ngas sbyin bdag gnyis la/‘‘nga 'chang sa rgyag gi min/ slob grwa la 'gro gi yin/ khyed rang gnyis nga'i drin chen pha ma dang gcig mtshungs yin/ khyed gnyis kyis gang bsgo༄ pa de ngas byed gi yin/’’ zhes bzhad pa yin/ de nas phar tshur yig 'brel byas ce mthar nga dhe ra dhun (2dzismo1'i 05ba)zer ba'i sa cha der yod pa'i long ba'i slob grwa la bskyal ba red/ khong gnyis la mo ṭa yod stabs nga sturdo zhogs ka snga po nas sim la nas thon te nyin gung chu tsod bzhi ba yol tsam la slob grwa der slebs song /

'i+o/ོnga ba'i slob grwa de ni 1074 lo'i dbyar thog red/ nga phal cher lo 3༷ tsam red/ slob grwa de la mig long ba'i slob ma sha stag yod pa red/ thog mar slebs skabs nga la slob grwa'i gnas stangs skor 'grel bshad byas song / long ba 'ophrog bzos pa'i ca lag mang po ston gyi 'dug 'gyig gi skud pas slas pa'i rkub stegs dang cog tse chung chung 〈snags red/ nga la nyal khang nang gi nyal khri sogs mig med mkhan tshos khrid nas ston gyi 'dug slob ma rnying pa tshos slob ma gsar pa la rogs byed kyi 'dug nyi ma kha shas kyi ring nged kyis za ma gang du za ba dang / de bzhin nyal khang dang gsang spyod gang du yod med sogs sbyangs pa yin/ slob grwa'i 'dzin skyong gis nga la/‘‘khyed rang zla ba gsum gyi ring 'dir tshod lta byed kyi yin/ de'i ring yi ge tog tsam shes song na/ mu mthud nas lo gnyis ring nyar gyi yin/ de min 'gro dgos pa red/’’ ces zer/ngas mu mazud nas slob grwa der yi ge sbyong ba dang lag shes sbyong ba sogs la 'bad pa byas pa yin/ nga'i spyin bdag gnyis kyi sems la ngas dbyin ji'i yi ge zhig kyang shes na bsams pa 'dra/ yin na yang / ngas skad yig gnyis dus gcig la shes thub pa mi 'dug de bas hin rdi'i skad yig la shugs brgyab nas

long ba'i slob grwa/ 35sbyangs pa yin/ rgya gar du mi tshe bskyal dgos phyin hin rdi'i skad nga la dgos mkho che gi red bsams byung / lo gnyis kyi nang / nga'i skad yig yar rgyas la song ba ma zad/ ngas lag shes kyang mang tsam shes par gyur/ yi ge de tsho long ba'i ched bzos pa'i gtsags yig (2nga'i111dzi)red/ mdzub mos myangs nas yi ge 'di 'don dgos/ nga'i slob sbyong dang las ka la grub 'bras yag po byung stabs slob grwa'i las byed kyis nga la lo gcig 'phar ma sbrad byung /mtshams 'dir yang bskyar gnas tshul gsar ba zhig dang 'phrad/ de ni/ ldi li nas nga tsho'i slob grwa'i dbu 'dzin zhig slob grwa la blta bar yong / de dus khos nga bod pa yin pa shes stabs/ khos rgya nag gzhung tshab la 'brel ba byas te/ bod pa 'di 'dra zhig nga snu'i slob grwa'i nang yod stabs bod la gtong thabs byed dgos skor yi ge bris pa red/ rgya nag gzhung tshab khang gis nga snu'i slob grwa la yi ge yong nas/ nga'i kha byang dang sa gnas gsal bor shes tshe/ lam la ma chas pa'i zla ba gnyis tsam gyi sngon nas yi ge btang na khong tshos rogs pa byed kyi yin zhes bshad 'dug mtshams der nga yang sems la dga' skyo gnyis ka yong / gcig byas na khong tsho'i rogs la brten nas pha yul du log thub kyi red/ 'on kyang don 'di nged gcig pus thag gcod byed ma thub/ ngas sbyin bdag bza' tsho gnyis la de'i skor yi ge btang ba yin/ yig lan nang khong māme nga la/‘‘deng sang bod yongs rdzogs rgya nag dmar zhog gis bzung nas skyid po yod pa ma red/ byas tsang / bod la ma 'gro/’’ zhes bzhad pa red/ de nas ngas slob grwa'i mgo khrid la nga bod la log gi min zhes bshad pa yin/

o tsi/ snying rje/1khya74 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya nag tu chibs bsgyur gnang zhing / lo 'di dag tu bod nang rgya nag dmar po'i dbang shugs slebs nas lo ngo kha shas song zhing / rgya dmar gyi dmag dpon snus bod kyi srol rgyun lam lugs la the gtogs byed shugs rje cher 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs shig red/ rgya gar gyi byang chub chen po'i chos stubis kyis gdan zhus ltar/ 7gong sa mchog dang kun gzigs pan chen rin po che rnam gnyis 1rtse7ca lor rgya gar du ston pa myang 'das kyi lo 27༷༷ 'khor ba'i dus dran mdzad sgor phebs/1rtse70 lo'i lha sa'i smon lam chen mo de ni lo rgyus nang zing cha dang dngangs 'tshab che ba'i smon lam zhig chagasga/ 7gong sa mchog gis lo der lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i grwa skor dam bca'i mtshan rtags bzhes/ bka' blon sbug nas thon pa'i yul phyogs so so'i gsar 'gyur me long phyi zla 2 naso 3 zhes pa'i gsar shog gi nang gsal ltar na/ lo de'i zla 2 tshes 21 nyin bka' blon sbyag khul du yod pa'i bod rigs 7༷༷༷ lhag tsam gyis 7gong sa mchog gi chos kyi mdzad sgo la dmigs pa'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo mdzad cing / da dung sgang

o tsi/ snying rje/ 37tog dang rdor gling / ka li ka ta sogs su yang bod rigs tshos de lugs kyi mdzad sgo spel yod pa red/ da dung 'phags yul khyal sdod bod rigs ser skya spyi mgrin nas 7gong sa mchog gi sku tshe brtan pa'i gsol 'debs snyan zhu phul/ 'di la gzhigs tshe skabs 'dir ma mthar yang bod mi stong phrag brgyad yas mas zhig rgya gar khyal du yod pa'i gnas tshul cedi dpag byed thub/ rtsom pa pos bris pa'i 3465na/phyi lo 107ca lor bod nas 7rgyal ba rin po che dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis rgya gar la phebs pa red/ khong rnam gnyis ldi li (0dzi1khyi1 )la phebs yod pa red ces rgya gar gyi gsar 'gyur nas yang yang go byung / yin na yang / nga la rogs pa byed mkhan med stabs nga ldi li la phyin med/ mtshams shrīg la khong rnam gnyis rdo rje gdan la phebs gi red ces go byung / rdo rje gdan la nga'i pha yul gcig pa a mdo ba mang po yod/ nga la rogs pa byed mkhan kyang 'ga' zhig yod/de bas ngas kyang me 'khor gyi 'dzin yig nyos nas nga gcig pu rdo rje gdan la phyin pa yin/ wa ra na sir slebs skabs bod kyi grwa gzhon 'ga' zhig me 'khor nang 'asbyol song / mtshams zhig la khong ces rgya gar ba sran ma brngos ma batheng mkhan skor zhig dang mnyam du sran ma'i ched rtsod ba tog tsam byed kyi 'dug mtshams der ngas/‘‘dge 'dun pa ces de ltar gnang na yag po yod ma red/ khong tsho snyom chung sran ma bathong mkhan red/ nyo gi yin na nyos/ nyo gi min na brnyas bcos ma byed/’’

38 55 khu pad ma/ces bshad pa yin/ khong tsho yud tsam la hon 'thor pa 'dra/ mtshams zhig nas/‘‘a tsi/ rgya gar ba 'dis bod skad bshad kyi 'dug’’ ces bshad song /ngas dor ma gon yod stabs khong 665 nga rgya gar ba zhig red bsams pa red/sang nyin der nga tsho rdo rje gdan me 'khor babs tshigs nas babs te rdo rje gdan mchod rten bar du nga therdomanyam du phyin pa yin/nga rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten la slebs dus pha yul gcig pa'i mi mang po la thug byung / bka' blon sbug nas yong ba'i a mdo bud med kha shas shig 'dugakhong thos nga yang khong tso'i mnyam du 'dug rgyu'i rogs ram byed zer ba ltar nga tsho mnyam du bsdad pa yin/nga'i mi che'i nang 7rgyal ba rin po che thengs dang por mjal gyi yod/ byas tsang nga tsho mjal kha'i ched yang bskyar wa ra na si la phyin pa yin/ 7rgyal ba rin po cher ngas dbyin ji'i yi ge'i nang gnas tshul kha shas bris pa zhig phul ba yin/ de la gang yang gsungs ma song / khong gi sku mdun pa zhig gis nga phyi logs la 'khrid nas sang nyin yang bskyar mjal kha la shog ces gsungs song / de'i dgong mor paṇa chen rin po che yang mchod rten la phebs kyi yod pa de la mjal khar phyin pa yin/ de dus nga paṇa chen rin po che'i ma yum la mjal ba yin/ ma yum gyi 'khris la bcar nas mjal kha zhig zhus pa yin/ ma yum gyis/‘‘o khyo gang nas yin/’’6‘nga a mdo nas yin/’’

o tsi/ snying rje/ 39‘‘a mdo gang gi yin/’’‘6a mdo reb gong gi yin/’’‘‘snying rje/ snying rje 'a ’’‘‘nga la mjal kha zhig yong ba'i rogs ram gnang rogs/’’‘‘los yin/ khyo sang nyin shog a snying rje/’’sang nyin der nga rgyal ba rin po cher mjal kha zhu ru song / ngas hin rdi'i skad kyis sku srung ba tshor nga 7rgyal ba rin po cher mjal kha zhu dgos yod ces bshad/mtshams thig la khong tshos nga khang pa zhig gi bar khyams lta bu zhig la khrid song /yud tsam nas 7sku mdun phyi logs la phebs song / khong gis nga'i lo rgyus shig bka' 'dri gnang song / mtshams der khong gis nga sa la sdod gsungs nas nga la ma ṇi'i lung zhig gnang song / ‘‘ma ṇi yag po thon a/’’ zhes gsungs song /mjal kha grub nas mar yong skabs 7sku mdun gyis nga la sgor mo sum brgya gsol ras gnang byung / yongs 'dzin rnam pa gnyis yin nam de 'dra zhig gis kyang nga la sgor mo nyi shu nyi shu gnang song /de nas nga paṇa chen rin po cher mjal khar phyin pa yin/ mi tshogs dang mnyam du mjal kha'i bang bsgrigs yod dus ma yum gyis nga mthong pa 'dra/ nga yar skad btang byung / ma yum gyis nga la gsol ras sgor mo sum brgya zhig gnang byung /de nas nga la rogs pa zhig btsal nas yul la yong na lam kha sogs stabs bde ru song yod ces bka' gnang song / nga'i rogs pas bshad pa ltar na ma yum

40 55 khu pad ma/gyis mtshams der sbyan chab shor gi 'dug zer/ de nas nga rdo rje gdan la phyin nas yang paṇa chen rin po cher mjal kha zhig zhus pa yin/ 'di tsho ni nga'i mi che'i nang 7rgyal ba paṇa chen la mjal kha zhus pa thengs dang po yin/ mjal kha zhus pa'i nyin der nga phyug po chags song / nga la sgor mo drug brgya lhag tsam yod/rdo rje gdan nas nga dhe ra dhun la log pa yin/ nged kyis rang gi sgor mo yod tshad de rked pa la bcangs nas 〉gis rdzas sogs zas rigs spus legs yod pa rnams 'khyer te me 'khor nang 'dzul ba yin/ yin na yang ngas me 'khor gyi lag khyer nyos med/ mtshams thig lag khyer lta rtog byed mkhan slebs song / ngas hin rdi'i skad mi shes pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa yin/ khos nga la gshe gshe gtong gi 'dug‘‘'o ma dang zas rigs spus legs za gi yod pa red/ yin na ying lag khyer nyo thub kyi yod pa ma red/ kho phyi logs la rgyugs/’’ zer/de nas mi gcig skad btang nas nga phyi logs la 'khrid bcug ngas 'khrid mi de la/‘6nga phyi logs la ma 'ded/ nga la mig yod pa ma red/’’ ces bshad pa yin/tabatheg/ ‘‘yong gi ma red/ bha bhu gis da dung lta gi 'dug’ri ces bshad song / yin na yang yun tsam nas khos/‘‘ṅgā'o ju'o ’’ zhes bshad nas nga yang bskyar me 'khor nang du 'gro bcug

o tsi/ snying rje/ 4sprosong / de ltar nga dhe ra dhun la slebs pa yin/ de nas nga'i slob grwa'i las ka yang tshar song / nga yang bkra shis lo legs kyi ngang nas slob grwa thon pa red/ nga'i sbyin bdag pha ma gnyis kyang rang yul a mi ri ka la 'gro ran pa red/ byas tsang nga khong gnyis bskyal bar rgyal sa ldi li bar du phyin pa yin/ de dus nga tsho mu mathrud 'brel ba yong ched kha byang sogs kyang gnang mod/ mtshams shig ngas yig cha mi dgos pa me la sreg skabs kha byang yang de'i nang shor nas nga la kha byang de ma thob pa red/ de nas bzung ngas khong gnyis la 'brel ba byed ma thub pa red/slob grwa thon nas bka' blon sbyag la phyin pa yin/ nga yang pha yul la log thub kyi red bsams pa'i re ba zhig yod/ reb gong rong bo dgon pa'i bla ma a lags khri rgan tshang gis rong po sbyi so'i tshogis zangs zhig bzhengs yod pa de rgya gar nas bod du gdan 'dren zhu dgos kyi yod pa red/ de dus ngas khyed rang yul la khrid dgos zer ba'i skad cha de 'dra zhig a lags khri rgan tshang gis nga'i rna nang la bzhag yod pa red/ nga yar de'i skor la skad cha 'dri ru phyin pa yin/ a lags khri rgan tshang gis nga la bshad don/‘‘pha yul gyi gnas tshul zhig yong rgyu yod/ de yong ba yin na 'gro thub min ha go gi red/’’ zer/ byas tsang / nga rang bka' blon sbyag nas gnas tshul de la sgug nas zla ba kha shas ring bsdad pa yin/ rjes nas khong gis/‘8pha yul la 'gro thub sa ma red/ pha yul tshang ma rgya gung khran gyis bzung 'dug lo kha shas la ma bsdad na 'gro thub sa ma red/’’ zer/

lha sa shor pa red/a khu pad ma rang lo 34 la slebs pa'i skabs 'dir bod shor pa red/ 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor dang bcas pa yang phyi lo 1rtse7lnga le'i phyi zla 3 tshes 31nyin rgya gar sa mtshams su phebs 'byor gnang zhing / mon rta dbang dang ti dzi pur sogs brgyud phyi zla 4 tshes 21 nyin ma su ri zhes pa'i sa gnas su rgya gar gzhung gis gra sgrig zhus pa'i bhir lā khang zhes pa'i pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/phyi zla 4 tshes 24 nyin rgya gar gyi srid blon zheharu dang mjal 'phrad gnang /bod rigs byings khrod nas kyang mi grangs stong phrag re bcas phyogs gang sa nas rgya gar du btsan byol la 'byor bzhin yod/yul phyogs so so'i gsar 'gyur me long / sbyi lo 1lnga70 spyi zla lnga/1༷dus tshes can gyi gsar shog nang 'di ltar/ bod nas rgya gar du skyabs bcol du phebs pa rnams kyi gnas tshul/ bod du rgya dmar gung bran gyi btsan dbang 'og nas thar te rgya gar du skyabs bcol du phebs mkhan ser skya mi dmangs ha lam chig khri lnga stong tsam phebs pa rnams la rgya gar gzhung gis grogs mgon chen po gnang mus/ dge 'dun gyi sde chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam sbag sa dwar du phyag dpe

lha sa sgor pa red/ 43sogs slob gnyer gnang ste bzhugs thabs dang / rgyud grwa stod smad kyi dge 'dun rnams ḍal ha'o si zhes pa'i sa bsil gnas su dge sbyor cho ga phyag len gnang ste bzhugs thabs dang / mi skya dpung dmag rnams kyis gnas skabs lam bakhro'i phyag las dang / sku gzhon rnams la yi ge yon tan slob gnyer gnang thabs sogs gnang mus su mchis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla spul khag sku yon rig gnas mkhas pa rnams rgya gar gyi gtsug lag khang khag tu legs sbyar dang hin di'i skad yig slob gnyer thog rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bod yig slob gnyer gnang thabs sogs kyi thabs shes gnang mus su mchis pa'i gnas tshul mdor bsdus/ zhes 'khod 'dug rtsom pa pos btus/1lnga70 lo red/ lha sa shor pa red/ bod mi dang rgya mi'i bar dmag 'khyug langs pa red ces pa'i skad cha de bod pa'i sbyi stugs nang khyab song / nga rang bka' blon spug na yod/ de nas nyin ma kha shas zhig gi rjes la 7rgyal ba rin po che rgya gar gyi mi sā ma ris (lo1 sdu5tshi71sa )zhes pa'i sa cha la mon rta dbang brgyud nas phebs pa red/ zer ba de khyab bsgrags byas song / de nas bka' blon sbug rdo rje gling / sgang tog sogs kyi mi mang pos 7rgyal ba rin po cher phebs bsu zhu bar 'tshang kha zhig zhig gis 'gro gi 'dug nga song med/ rjes mar rdo rje gdan nas mjal kha reg gi red bsams nas bsdod pa yin/ nga sdod sa'i gnas tshang tshang yang sang nas mjal kha zhus nas yag pa byung 'dug

44 a khu pad ma/de nas nga rang rdo rje gdan la phyin pa yin/ de 1⑩7rtse lo'i dbyar kha'i zla ba bzhi pa lnga pa de 'dra zhig la red/ rdo rje gdan nas sdod dgos bsams pa yin rung tsha ba yang chen po 'dug rdo rje gdan gyi grwa ba kha shas 7rgyal ba rin po che mu su ri (smo55500‘1 dzi)la phebs yod pa der mjal khar 'gro gi 'dug nga rang yang kho tsho'i mnyam tu 7rgyal ba rin po cher mjal tu phyin pa yin/ de la phyin dus ngas ngo shes pa de 'dra btsal/ las ka zhig 'a'ephrog dgos bsam ste las mgo 'dra bo zhig btsugs bsdad pa'i skabs la 7skyabs mgon rin po cher mjal kha zhu bar 'gro dgos kyi yod rung / 7rgyal ba rin po cher mjal kha zhu mkhan de 'drar skad shes mkhan med pas kho 665 phan tshun go brda ma 'phrod pa de snu'i skad bsgyur 'dra byas nas nyin shas ring la rogs byas pa yin/nyin gcig la nga rang gis kyang so so'i mi che'i thog la bsam blo btang ba yin/ sa gnas der bod kyi gdan sa'i mkhan po mang po bzhugs yod pa red zer/nyin gcig der mjal bar phyin pa yin/ der mkhan po tshos khyed rang la ga re byung song zer ba sogs lo rgyus mang po dris song / de tshang mar lan brgyab/nga rang a ri'i bza' mi gnyis kyis bdag nyar byas nas mig med pa'i slob grwa'i nang btang / yi ge 'dra bslab/ las ka 'dra bslab/ de 'dra de 'dra byas pa red/ ces lo rgyus bshad dus kho tsho yang ha las/ kho tsho nga'i mtha' skor du gor gor byas te bzhugs/ nga rang la kha mtshar bshad/ de nas khong snus nga la nga'i yi

lha sa shor pa red/ 45ge dang yi ge gtsags spyad kyi lag cha de tsho tshang ma nga'i lag par yod pa de tsho khyer shog zer/ phyi nyin ngas de tsho khyer song nas ngas mdzub mo'i thog nas yi ge de tsho bklags/ yi ge gtsags spyad steng nas yi ge 'di 'dra byas nas gtsags dgos pa red ces bshad nas kho rmetshor bstan pa yin/ mkhan po gcig gis nga la/‘‘yi ge bris yod pa de ga re red/’’ ces gsungs/‘‘de hin rdi'i yi ge red/’’ zhus pa yin/‘‘yi ge de tsho'i nang don ga re red/’’ gsungs/‘‘yi ge 'di tsho'i nang don ni sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs red/’’ ces zhus/‘‘de yin na/ de dag nga tsho la klog rogs/’’ gsungs song bar ngas yi ge rnams mdzub mos klog zhor/ dang po sangs rgyas kyi 'khyungs rabs/ rgyal sa nas dka' ba spyad pa'i skabs la/ bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga nyin khong phyi logs la phebs pa'i lo rgyus de bshad pa'i sgang la khong zlos/‘‘bden pa red/ bden pa red/ dngos gnas de ga rang red/’’ ces gsungs nas khong tsho ha las kyi 'dug de nas ngas/‘6ngas 7rgyal ba rin po cher mjal kha zhu dgos kyi 'dug khyed rang rnam pas nga la rogs ram gnang rogs/’ri zhes zhus pa yin/ de dus khong tshos bshad rgyur/‘67rgyal ba rin po che bzhugs sa'i rgyab logs na zur khang chen mo bzhugs bsdad yod pa red/ khong gi sku mdun la bcar nas zhus dang khyed rang la rogs pa bya thub kyi red/’’ ces gsungs song / de nas ngas rogs pa cig khrid nas zur khang chen mo'i sku mdun la bcar pa yin/ de dus lus la gon pa yag po zhig kyang

46 lug khu pad ma/yod pa ma red/ stod thung dang rkang thung gon/ gzan dkar po zhig khog stod la g.yugs/ rogs pas khrid nas khong gi sgo rtsar slebs dus/ khong gi lcam sku zhabs la thug sang /‘‘kho ga re yin pa/ kho ga re byas pa red/’’ ces rogs par 'dri gi 'dug‘‘nga mig med pa'i long ba zhig yin/ nga rang a mdo ba zhig yin/ da ngas 7rgyal ba rin po cher mjal kha zhig zhu ba yin/’’ zhus pa yin/‘‘ya ya/ khyed rang sgug a/ nga rang gis yar la zhu dgos/ khyed rang shog a/’’ gsungs kyi 'dug de dus lcam sku zhabs des snying rje bsam nas mig chu zhig btang song zer/ de nas nga sku lnga'i sku mdun la bcar pa yin/ sku ngo gnyis 'dug kho gnyis kyis nga'i lo rgyus 'dri gi 'dug kho gnyis kyis/‘‘da khyed rang gis bsam blo la ga re 'khor gyi 'dug’’ zer/‘8da nga'i bsam blo la gang yang med/ nga rang sbrang bo byas te bsdad nas/ ga sa ga la slong brgyab nas/ dgun kha re rer rdo rje gdan la song nas bsdad na ma gtogs/ nga la spun nye sogs bdag po gang yang yod pa ma red/ de ma gtogs/nga la sa mtha' na bdag po gang yang med/’’ ces zhus pa yin/‘‘da cha ḍal hor (0smo'i10551 dzi)zer ba'i sa cha der rgan rgon gtong gi yod pa red/ 65 mdo ba yang yod pa red/ khams pa yang yod pa red/ dbus pa yang yod pa red/ rgan gso khang la las ka bya mkhan gtong gi yod pa red/ nga ces khyed rang der gtong ba'i thabs shes byas na gang 'dra 'dug ngas bltas na khyed rang la de yag po 'dug der khyed la ma shi bar du kha lag rag gi red/’’ ces

lha sa shor pa red/ 47zer yang /‘‘rgan gso khang la song na khyed tsho a mdo ba de tsho yang yod kyi red/ gcig gis bdag po brgyab bzhag gi red/’’ ces zer/ de nas khong gnyis kyis mu mthud nas/‘‘khyed rang la mjal kha sang nyin rag gi red/ sang nyin khyed sgo chen gyi 'khris kyi mjal kha zhu sa der shog’’ zer/ phyi nyin der nga sgo rtsar bcar ba yin/mi gcig gis/‘‘pad+ma/ pad+ma yar shog’’ ces skad brgyab song / ngas rogs pa la khrid bcug de nas thad kar nga 7sku mdun gyi 'khris la khrid song / 7skyabs mgon rin po cher mjal/ gzham der sku drag mang po dang rgya gar gyi sku tshab mang po bzhugs 'dug nga rang sar bsdad pa na rgya gar dpon po chen po des nga la nyin rdi'i skad thog nas nga'i gnas stangs dang lo rgyus dris song / ngas phyir hin rdi'i skad bshad nas nga rang dhe ra dhun la mig med pa'i slob grwa nang la song / der slob yun lo gnyis dang yang bskyar dmigs bsal gyis lo gcig bcas lo gsum la slob grwar bsnad de hin rdi'i bslab pa yin zhes zhus pa yin/ las ka ga re bslab pa yin zer/ las ka rkub stegs sles pa sogs sna kha drug bdun zhig bslab pa yin zhes zhus pa yin/ khong gis nga la khyed rang gis hin rdi'i skad yag po shes kyi 'dug zer/ de nas kho thos yige 'di klog gsungs byung / ngas mdzub mo bed spyod byas nas yi ge de tsho bklags pa yin/ 7sku mdun dang der yod tshang ma bzhad mo bzhang kyi 'dug der dbyin ji'i skad bsgyur cig 'dug 7gong sa mchog gis kho la

48 a khu pad ma/bka' gnang nas nga rang ḍal hor la gtong na ldi li la snyan seng phul dgos pa red ces gsungs song /mjal kha grub nas nga phyi logs la yong skabs sku ngo nas 'di 'dra gsung gi 'dug‘‘khyed rang 'dir nyin kha shas la sgug ldi li nas yi ge slebs na khyed rang ḍal hor la gtong gi red/ khyed rang la pa se sogs dgos kyi yod pa ma red/’’nga sdod sa nas 7sku mdun bzhugs sa bar thag ring po yod pa red/ nyin gcig la nga rang gis mi gcig la skad bsgyur byed bzhin pa'i skabs la mi gcig gis nga skad btang song / khos bshad don la/‘‘da khyed rang gi ca lag sogs tshang ma khyer shog khyed de ring nga tsho'i dpon po zhig dang mnyam du ḍal hor la 'gro dgos kyi 'dug’’ zer/ de nas khos rta gha ril gyi gla cha sbrad nas lam gyi phyed ka la slebs yod pa'i skabs la rjes nas mo ṭa zhig slebs song /‘6khyed rang ca lag len du 'gro long mi 'dug sku ngo slebs song ’’ zer nga de nas mo ṭa'i nang la bcug song / ngas rang gis gon pa'i gyon chas rnams ma gtogs nyal chas sogs gcig kyang khyer med/ de nas me 'khor 'bab tshigs la slebs nas sgug bsnad pa yin/ skabs der sku ngo su zhig yin pa yang shes kyi

lha sa shor pa red/ 49med/ kho la zhabs zhu gnyis 'dug de'i mtshan gang bor nga tsho me 'khor la phyin pa yin/ phyi nyin zhogs pa nam langs dus nga tsho pa k+ṣang ko ṭi (2'i khyi'isloṣā0rdu)zhes pa'i me 'khor 'bab tshigs de la slebs song / de nas nga tsho ḍal hor la mo ṭa'i nang 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ mo ṭa ma slebs sngon la ngas der yod pa'i zhabs zhu gcig la nga rang gcin pa gtong sar khrid rogs gnang zhus pa yin/ skabs der ngas nga tsho'i sku ngo 'di su zhig yin pa skad cha dris pa yin/ zhabs zhus nga la khong kun bde gling dza sag red zer/ de nas ngas sku ngo su yin pa gzhi nas shes/ nga snus me 'khor 'bab tshigs nas kha lag zas rjes ḍal hor la phyin pa yin/ chu stubi bzhi lnga zhig 'gro dgos kyi 'dug

zha ra dang la tsā ba/btsan byol bod ga/zhung gi yig cha khag tu 'khod pa ltar na/ rgya gar gzhung gis1ci7lnga lo'i phyi zla 11 pa'i nang / ḍal hor btsan byol bod mi'i lag shes bzo las khang de btsus/sa pa dang / thog ma'i dmigs yul ni bod kyi lag shes rigs slob sbyong dang rim gyis bzo tshong gi ngo bo can la bsgrur thub pa'i ched red/dmiges yul de gzhir bzung nas mi sa ma ri zhes pa'i sa cha'i 'phral sel gzhis chags nas bod rigs 7༷༷ ḍal hor khyal du btang ba red/ 1lngaca2lor bzo grwa'i 'dzin skyong de dag btsan byol gzhung gis rtsis len byas/ de ni mgo 'asbyogs kyi dus skabs ring bzo grwa'i thon skyed yid tshim pa ma byung ba'i dbang gis red/ skabs 'dir mi grangs 42rtse shong ba'i rgan gso dang dbang po skyon can bdag gnyer khang zhig rgya gar gzhung gis mthun rkyen sbyar te ḍal hor khul du btsugs 'dug rtsom pa pos bris pa'i mchan/nga tsho ḍal hor la slebs pa dang der bod mi tshome sku ngo phebs kyi yod pa red ces mi mang pos lam kha la sgug 'dug nga zhabs zhu gcig gis khrid bsdad yod/ngas mig shel nag po zhig gon yod stabs mi ces nga zha ra cig yin pa shes med

zha ra dang lo tsā ba/ 5spropa 'dra bo 'dug da nga snu'i skad bsgyur ba slebs song ba red ces mi mang gis de ltar bshad kyi 'dug zer/ dngos gnas bshad na nga skad bsgyur ba ma red/ nga yang sku ngo phebs nas ja bzhugs zhu sa'i sbug la song / sku ngo'i zhabs zhu rnams dang mnyam du de'i mtha' zhig nas bsdad pa yin/ de'i nang la a mdo legs bshad zer ba'i a mdo ba gcig kyang 'dug nged kyi sems la nga lam seng rgan rgon bsdad sa'i rgan gso khang la btang na bsams rung btang ma song / sku ngo des nga nyin kha shas la khong dang mnyam du 'dug dgos pa red ces gsung gi 'dug ces zhabs zhu ྅65 nga la bshad song /kho rā'i mnyam du zhal lag zas/ kho tshos phogs za gi mi 'dug de nas ngas skad shes kyi yod pas kho tshos nga la skad cha dris/ tshig 'di dang de la ga re zer gyi yod pa red zer ba lta bu'i dri ba dris/ kho tsoyi ge sbyangs pa'i ma khas pa rkyang yin pa red/ dgong mor gon pa med pas nyin gnyis pa nas a mdo legs bshad zer ba kho la rta'i sga shed rta kheb cig 'dug pa de gon pa ma gtogs/ kho la yang g.yar rgyu'i gyon pa gang yang mi 'dug kho la kam pa li gcig ma gtogs mi 'dug de gon nas nyin grangs brgyad la khong tshang nas bsdad pa yin/nyin gcig ldi li nas dpon po phebs song / gzhung gi nang srid kyi dpon po zhig phebs nas kun bde gling dang kho thos skad cha tag tag bzos yod pa red pa/der kar sgo nas yin pa'i skad bsgyur cig 'dug kho dbyin ji dang nyin rdi'i skad ha

52 55 khu pad ma/cang yag po yod pa red/ yin na yang kho'i skad de la dwags kyi skad 'dra bo cig rgyag pa de la mi tshang mo u thug bsnad 'dug de nas nga la skad bsgyur khyed rang gis byos zhes bshad sang /skad bsgyur gang 'dra bya dgos ba red zer na/ rgya gar dpon po yis mar hin rdi'i thog gang bshad pa de kun bde gling sku ngo dang mi dmangs kyis nyan dgos kyi yod pa red/ dpon pos gsungs ba de yar sku ngo la zhus pa dang mnyam du mi dmangs sum brgya tsam gyis kyang nyan bsdad yod pa red/ 'di ngas ḍal hor la skad bsgyur byas pa thengs dang po red/dpon po des ḍal hor zer ba'i sa cha 'dir bod shor nas skyabs bcol la yong pa khyed rang tsho nga lho'i grong pa khyim mtshes nang la sku mgron la slebs pa red/de yin dus nga tshokla rgan rgon tshang ma la bsdad sa'i sa cha yag sa/ ri yod sa/zhing nags yod sa/ sa cha bsil bo de 'dra la bsams nas nga snus ḍal hor 'di gra sgrig byas yod zer ba'i thog la gsung bshad mang po gnang song / gang yin zer na 'dir yong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rgan rgon tshang ma 'dir bsdad/ de'i skabs der gzhon pa mang po len rgyu'i skor la gsung bzhad gnang ma song /‘‘khyed snu'i bod shor ba red/ blo pham dgos pa ma red/ da khyed tshos bsam blo ga re gtong dgos pa red zer na/ sa la ril nas yar rkang pa'i thog la langs

zha ra dang lo tsā ba/ 53thub pa'i las ka bya dgos pa red/ las ka bya ba la dang po las ka chung chung lag shes bslab kyi yin/ las ka dang mnyam du slob sbyong yang hin rdi'i skad yig bslab kyi yin/ dbyin ji'i skad yig gi slob grwa 'dzugs kyi red/ de tshang ma'i thad nga tsho rgya gar gzhung la gra sgrig yod/ da bzo grwa'i mgo spyi de tsho yang 'dir phebs bsdad yod pa red/ bzo grwa'i las ka byed stangs de tsho kho tshos bshad kyi red/’’gsung bzhad gnangawā de ngos mar la skad bsgyur byed dgos po red/ der kun bde gling yang bzhugs bsdad yad pa red/ grwa ba dang bla ma mang pa bzhugs bsnad yod pa red/ ngas ha go ma song yang / phyis su go thos la mi dmangs nang la mig chu gtong mkhan yang 'dug zer/ nga tsho bod shor nas sa mtha' 'dir yong ste/ nga tsho grwa ba rkyang red/ lag shes lham bzo ba dang thag 'thag pa'i las rigs 'di dag ni nga tsho grwa ba'i las ka min la/ nga snurme las ka de tsho byed kyi min zhes sems skyo pa red/ rjes nas dpon po la de tsho grwa ba'i las ka min tshul zhu rogs bshad nas ngas zhus yod/ de nas kun bde gling nas kyang /‘‘da lta dpon pos gsungs pa la/ nga tsos rang gi sa cha len pa la ga re bya dgos pa red zer na/ nga cos sa mtha' slebs song zer nas nyal bsdad rgyu yod pa ma red/ so sos skad sogs shes pa byas nas las ka zhig bya dgos pa red ma gtogs/ lto chas dang phogs zos nas sdod rgyu yod pa ma red/ 'dir nga ces 'gro stangs dang 'dug stangs gang yang shes kyi yod ma red/ 'dir ltos dang / de ring mig med mkhan zhig gis nga stung skad bsgyur bya dgos kyi 'dug ga da nga tsho khu(thug

54 a khu pad ma/'dug ga nga snu'i rogs pa gcig gis kyang dus 'dir skad shes mkhan yod pa ma red/ mig med mkhan zhig gis skad shes kyi yod pa red/ kho la mig gnyis cha yod pa ma red/’ri ces khyab bsgrags byas song /de ltar gal srid sa gnas 'dir bzo grwa'i slob grwa sogs tshugs song na/'dir phebs pa'i mi mang tshos slob sbyong byas te/ tha na so so chab gsang nang la 'gro ba dang / tshong khang nang nas nyo cha rgyag pa/ sman khang la 'gro ba sogs kyi tshig re gnyis re shes rung shes dgos pa red/ bzo grwa mgo btsugs pa dang mi mang tshos las ka byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ 'di lho'i skor gong rim nas rgyas pa'i thog nas mar gsung bshad gnang song / de nas sku ngos yar rgya gar dpon po la bzo grwa tshugs rgyu'i las 'char skor la gsung bshad gnang bar thugs rje che zhus song / de ltar ngas skad bsgyur thengs dang po byas pa red/de dus grwa ba dang bla ma che ru che tshad mang po yod pa red/ blo pham byung ba red/sa mtha' 'dir slebs nas 'di ltar bsdad na gang yang ma red/ de las rgya gar gzhung gi rogs ram 'og nga tsho mgyogs por phyir bod la log thub pa'i rogs ram gnang rogs zhes yar la zhu rogs bshad song / yar la zhu khyal byas rung de la rgya gar dbon po myos lan gnang don la/‘‘nga lho'i yan chad la 'dzom gling rgyal spyi yod pa red/ phyi logs la thon tshar dus lam seng phyir 'gro chog chog yod pa ma red/ khyed snu'i sa cha tshang ma rgyal

zha ra dang lo tsā ba/ 55khab gzhan gyis zas pa red/ de phyir len pa'i thabs shes ga re byed dgos pa red zer na/ da so so rang rang gi rkang pa'i sgang nas yar langs dgos pa red/’’ces lan gnang song / kho tshos go rgyu can gyi gtam zhig bshad pa red/de nas dpon po de phyi nyin phebs song ba red/ de nas bzung phogs len pa dang sman khang la 'gro ba sogs tshang mar 'gro stangs 'dug stangs shes kyi yod pa ma red/ tha na bud med rnams la gsang spyod logs kha yod pa yang ha go gi yod pa ma red/ skad bsgyur bya dgos kyi 'dug ces bshad mkhan yod rung med rung skad bsgyur ma byas rang byas red/ skad bsgyur ngo ma der bshad na kho tshos go gi mi 'dug zero/ dpo+on po zhig la skad cha bshad na yang nga skod gtong gi 'dug ngas kyang sa sas 'jan rung ma 'jan rung skad bsgyur byas yad/ dga' lngan klu 'bum khang tshan gyi grwa ba rgan pa dang bla ma phyag ma17da mang po yod pa red/ kho rakrus phar la spor shog zer nas phar la spor/ de 'dra byas nas nyin rtag par nga'i lag mgo la 'jus nas sman khang la 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ snu'i khang la 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ phogs len sar skad cha 'dri gi 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ rgya dpon la yang skad bsgyur bya dgos kyi yod pa red/ bya ba gang la yin rung nyin mtshan gnyis la khrid 'gro gi yod pa red/ nga'i nyi ma re re'i las ka de red/ bzo grwa'i mgo sbyis nga la da khyed rang bzo grwa nang gi dge rgan byos/ khyed rang gis lag shes slob pa sogs da bzo grwa 'dzugs kyi yin zer/ de nas yang bskyar mi dmangs la 'tshogis 'du 'acogis/ zla ba gnyis tsam phal cher 'gor yod/ de

56 55 khu pad ma/nas mi si ma ris nas gzhon pa mi lnga brgya cig btang yong song / khong tsho lo nyi shu yan chad dang lo sum cu'i man chad rkyang yin pa red/ mi lnga brgya de bzo grwa'i nang 'dzul ched ḍal hor la btang yong ba red/bzo grwa de thog mar tshugs skabs/ lag shes tsag tsig rigs te dber na/rkang sug (500ṣā5)sles pa sogs las ka chung chung de tsho skyes dman de thos shes kyi yod pa red/ de dus nyin gcig la gla cha a na bzhi ma gtogs yod pa ma red/zla gcig ring la nyin gcig kyang ma chag par las kar phyin na yang zla rer gla cha hin sgor drug dang a na bzhi ma gtogs 'bab kyi med/bzo grwa'i mgo sbyis nga la dngul phogs len gyi yin nam yang na phogs len gyi yin zhes dris song / dngul phogs blangs na nga la zla rer sgor brgya re sprod rgyu dang / phogs blangs na mkho chas nyo ched zla rer sgor nyer lnga re sbrod rgyu yin zer/de nas ngas phogs blangs na yag ga med dam zhus pa yin la/ mgo sbyis kyang khyed rang gis phogs zos na dga' gi red/ ces zer/ de ltar nga la zla ba rer sgor nyer lnga re sbrad/ bzo grwa'i dge rgan yang byas pa red/mtshams zhig la skyabs rje gling rin po che ḍal hor la phebs song / skabs der yang las khungs kyi dpon po de dang ldi li nas dpon po zhe drag mthon po min pa de 'dra zhig yong ba der skad bsgyur byed rgyur nga skad btang song / de nas ngas

zha ra dang lo tsā ba/ 57skyabs rje gling rin po che la skad bsgyur byas pa yin/ brgya dpon sogs skad btang ste snubs 'du 'tshogs nas las ka byed stangs/ bzo grwa rgyag stangs/ phogs sprad stangs/ phogs len stangs sogs sgrig khrims gang la gang 'tshams zhig bzos yod pa de skad bsgyur byas/ de nas skyabs rje gling rin po ches gsungs gsal la/thengs 'dir khyed rang tho'i ngos nas gla sgrig dpe mi srid pa'i yag po gnang yod pa red/ sa cha dang gang ci'i thad dpe yag po 'dug ces mar gsungs bshad gnang /de rjes nas bzung nga'i lo rgyus dang nga la mig med pa yang skyabs rje rin po ches mkhyen 'dug byas tsang khong gis bka' gnang don/‘‘pad ma la mig yod pa ma red/ sa cha rtsub po red/ lam kha sdug cag red/khyed rang snus kho la lag pas 'khrid nas 'gro ba'i rogs pa phar la bya dgos pa red/ khos tshur la yang rogs pa byed kyi yod pa red/’’ ces brgya dpon tsho la bka' gnang song / de nas brgya dpon thos kyang / ‘‘yin dang yin/ kho tshos rogs byed kyi yin/’mi ces zhus pa red la/ de nas nga la khang pa dmigs bsal sprad de nga la g.yog po+o gcigo kyango bzhag song / de nas bzung nga yar mar la khrid pa dang za ma bza ba sags khas rags pa byas sang /

nga'i 'chang sa gnyis pa dang gsum pa/mtshams shig nas nga snu'i rogs pa gcig gis nga la bsam nag 'dra bo byas te gros gzhi gsar pa zhig bton pa red/‘‘pad ma la brten sa 'dra bo gang yang yod ma red/ g.yog po btsugs nas khungs 'khyol gyi ma red/ de las kho la skyes dman cig btsal pa yin na yag po yod pa red/’’ ces zer/ de ltar skad cha 'di dang bsam tshul 'di yar mar la khyab cing / mtshams gcig nga la skyes dman len rgyu'i skad cha de byung ba red/ bu mo lo chung chung gcig yod pa red/ khams nang chen nas red/ phal cher bu mo de lo bcu drug bcu bdun la slebs tshar yod/ nga tsos bu mo la yang de'i skor skad cha bshad/ de nas bu mo'i pha ma gnyis la yang bshad pa red/ mtha' ma der bu mo des kyang khas blangs/ bu mo'i pha ma gnyis kyis kyang khas len byas/ ngas bu mo de mna' ma la len khyal byas nas bu mo'i nang mi tshang ma nga'i khang pa la blangs pa yin/ skabs der ngas khong tshor bshad de/ nga tsho tshang ma khang pa 'dir mnyam du bsnad na yong gi ma red/ gnas skabs ring mnyam du sdod dgos byung yang mtha' ma nga tsho logs ka byas nas sdod dgos kyi red/ ces bshad pa yin/ bu mo'i pha ma gnyis kyis ngas gang bshad de la khas len byed kyi 'dug nga tsos nga tsho'i khyim

nga'i 'chang sa gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ 59gzhis 'di'i skor la gros byas/ de nas nga snu'i bar yi ge bris/ de ltar nga gnyis gnyen sgyig byas pa red/ bu mo de yang yar bzo grwa'i nang la bcug de nas bar skabs cig la bza' tshang gnyis cha gsar ba yin tsang yag po yod pa red/ de nas nga gnyis lo gsum la mnyam du bsnad yod pa red/ rjes nas ngas mna' ma la gser gyi masbyob dkris chung chung gcig kyang g.yog gon pa yang yag po re bskon/ ngas yang bzo lta 'dra bo byas nas bzo grwa la song dus/ nga la mig yod pa ma red/ lo yang bzhi bcu yas mas cig yin rgyu red/ de dus nga yar mar la khrid pa yang bu mo des khrid kyi yod pa red/ thog ma'i skabs mo rang ngo tsha gi yod pa ma red/mtshams 'di 'dra zhig la nga'i skyes dman lo chung chung red/ 'gro stangs 'dug stangs bshad na/ mi kha shas kyispra brnyas bcos byas nas/‘‘khyed rang lo chung chung / khyo ga lo chen po/ mig zha ra red/’’ ces bshad yod sa red/ byas tsang / gang ltar mo'i sems nang la yang bsam tshul 'dra min cig yong yod pa red/ nga'i rna nang la skad cha 'dra min slebs yong gi 'dug zha ra 'dra bo de 'dra bshad yong na/ nga rang gi sems nang la bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig 'dug de bden pa red/ ngas lo chung chung 'di 'dra zhig mna' mar blangs pa de nor 'dug rjes ma zhig la g.yugs ni g.yugs ma thub/ gal srid nyin gcig lo chung mna' ma 'di'i ched du rnyog gzhi 'dra byung / nga rang gis mna' ma'i rgyab rtsa la langs khyal byas na/ khong khro langs na/ phar phyogs des nga'i mgo la gzhus na

60 55 khu pad ma/yang nga rang gi gyong red ma gtogs/ ngas gang yang bya thub kyi ma red/ de ltar bsam blo btang dus/ so sos rjes ma zhig la khyangs 'khyol gyi ma red snyam pa'i bsam blo 'khor gyi 'dug rjes ma nga rang gis kyang mna' ma'i skyon kha shas mthong song / skyabs rje khri byang rin po che ḍal hor la phebs pa'i skabs la mi tshang ma phebs bsu zhu bar bcar yod pa red/ rjes mar skyes dman gyi pha ma gnyis ma gtogs dbyangs skyid slebs mi 'dug ming la dbyangs skyid zer gyi yod/ rjes nas nang la slebs skabs mo yang slebs song / de nas nga rang la rnam rtog cig yod pa red pa/ byas tsang khong khro langs nas/66khyed rang ga bar phyin pa yin/’’‘‘nga mjal kha la song ba yin/’’‘‘khyod de na mi 'dug ces bzhad kyi 'dug ga bar phyin pa yin/ khyed rang 'khyams song ba red/’’ ces bzhad de 'khyugs pa cig brgyab/ de nas bzung nga rang gis kyang skyon cig mthong / nga rang gnyis gang ltar 'grig sa ma red bsam nas bsam blo btang ste nga rang gis lam kha gsar ba zhig btsal/ nga co'i da lta'i shes rig bka' blon thub bstan lung rigs kyi a pha'i spun rgya a ma dbyangs skyid zer pa'i a ye gcig yod pa red/ de nga'i khyim mtshes yin/ a ye des kyang cung tsam shes kyi yod pa red/ de bas skyes dman lo chung 'dis khyed rang la phan thogs kyi ma red ces nga la bshad kyi yod pa red/ a mdo shar ba nas yin pa'i a ye cig yod/ ming la gnam 'tsho zer/ de la khyed rang gis pad+ma la rogs pa zhig byed thub na/ khyed rang gnyis yul phyogs gcig pa red ces tshig zur zhig

nga'i 'chang sa gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ 6sprobaji+od yod pa dang / kho mos kyang blta gi yin zer ba tsam las thag bcad mi 'dug na yang / rjes nas mo rang gis phal cher yong gi red zer ba'i tshig cig nga'i rna nang la go song / de 'dra byung dus ngas kyang sems thag bcad nas khyangs mi 'khyol thag chod red bsam ste/ nyin cig yag po'i thog nas bza' tshang logs ka byas na yag po 'dug bsam ste/ dgung mo gcig la/ ngas sha nyos te pha yul bzhin sha btso / sha skal bgos pa yin/ mo rang la pha ma gnyis kyang yod pa red/ mo rang gi spun rgya gnyis yod pa de gnyis kyang yod pa red/ khong thos nga'i bza' tshang gi skor la gang yang bshad kyi mi 'dug pha ma gnyis kyis nga la rgyab skyor byed kyi 'dug kha lag zos rjes nga rang gis kho tsho la bshad don/‘‘de ring nga la skad cha bshad rgyu gcig yod/ de ring gi nyin mo 'di nga tsos mnyam gcig tu kha lag za ba'i go skabs tha ma de yin/ gang yin zer na/ nga rang gis bsam blo gtong phyogs dang po nas nor song ba red/ bu mo mosna rang sems pa bzang po red de/ rjes su mo rang la skyon yod pa mo rang gi sems nang yod pa red/mo rang la pha ma gnyis yod pa red/ khyod ces mnyam du bsdad kyi yin na mo rang gis bsam blo thongs/ gang ltar nga gnyis de ring nas bzung bza' tshang byas te mnyam du bsdad gi min/ da nga gnyis logs ka byas pa yin/’’ ces bshad dus/ khong ྅65/‘‘lam seng de 'dra bya dgos pa ma red/ mo rang gcig byas na yar rgyas 'gro rgyu yod rgyu red/’’ zer/ yin na yang / skyes dman mo rang gis kha ci yang mi grag par bsnad kyi 'dug

62 zhingakhu pad ma/‘‘da nga rang gnyis la cang bshad rgyu lhag yod pa ma red/ mo rang yang bden pa red/ lo chung chung red/ rjes ma cig la bza' tshang yag po zhig thob pa'i smon lam rgyag gi yod/ ngas mo la 'khyug pa rgyag pa dang sdug cag byed pa de 'dra min/nga rang la yang rogs pa cig thob pa byed kyi yin/ ma thob na yang ngas 'di ltar dka' sdug myangs nas yong ba red/ da dung yang dka' sdug myangs nas nga'i mi tshe bskyal dgos pa red/’zi ces bshad de bza' tshang 'thor ba'i thag gcod byas pa yin/phyi nyin de la mo rang yang nga'i khang ba nas spor ba red/ mo rang gi gyon chas yod pa de las kha shas shig khyer pa red/ kha shas thig ngas sbrad med/ de nas nyin kha shas rjes la mo la phru gu 'dug zer/ de go rjes ngas mo dang skad cha bshad pa'i go skabs zhig btsa'i/ nas/‘‘khyed rang phyir log gi yin nam/’’ ces dris/‘‘yong gi yin/’’ zer/ yin na yang nga snus thag bcad tshar ba red/‘‘khyed rang ga re byed kyi yin na'ang khyed rang gis bltas/ nga tsos ga le byas nas bsam blo gtong dgos/’’ ngas de ltar bshad pa yin/ rjes su bshad dus phru gu yod pa bden ba red 'dug‘‘phru gu de nged gnyis kyi yin pa bden pa red pas/’’6‘nga gnyis kyi min na sus red/’’ ces zer/ rjes nas mo rang la la dwags pa rgya gar gzhung gi so ba las khungs kyi las ka byed mkhan de 'dra cig la dga' gin 'dug zer ba de 'dra zhig ngas go song / phyis su la dwags pa de dang bza'

nga'i 'chang sa gnyis ba dang gsum pa/ 63tshang byas pa red la/ de nas nga rang gcig pur zla ba kha shas bsnad nas ngas yang a mdo a ye de mna' mar blangs pa yin/a mdo a ye de dang nga gnyis lo nyi shu tham pa'i ring mnyam du bsdad yod pa red/ mo rang a mdo shar pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang bon po red/ mo'i khyim ngo ma dang spun nye de tsho bon po red 'dug sim la na bon po'i gzhis chags so lan zer ba zhig yod pa red/ gzhis chags de la mo la pha gcig ma gcig gi spun nye de 'dra yod pa red/ de'i skal 'dra bo sbrad nas khyed rang phar la shog ces bshad song yang / mo rang gis 'gro gi min ces bshad nas phyin ma song /mo rang sngon mar rnying ma'i mi tshang zhig la mna' mar 'gro yod 'dug bon po khe gtsang ma gtogs rnying ma ba dang dge lugs pa yin tshe gzhis chags de'i nang la 'gro gi yod pa ma red/ mo rang gi spun nye tsos bzhad kyang mo rang gis de tsho'i ngag la nyan ma song / nga gnyis mnyam du bsdad nas mon gho (sa15saspulnga0spu)rgan gso khang la yong ba red/ de ltar nga lo lnga'i bar du bzo grwa'i nang bsdad pa dang /de nas 1lnga73lo bar du ḍa5 hor du yod pa'i rgan gso khang nang ju bsnad pa red/

zha ra yin yang / phan thogs yod/da ngas ḍal hor gyi skad bsgyur skor de mu mazud nas bshad kyi yin/ de ltar nga bzo grwa de'i nang nas lo gsum la skado bsgyur ngo ma'i go sa dang gnas babs med na yang skad bsgyar byas pa yin/ la gsum gyi ring la nyin rtag par skad bsgyur bya dgos kyi yordo pa red/ da tshags par cig gi thog bod kyi gnad don dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul zhig slebs yod na/ mi dmangs kyi sems pa gso ched du rgya gar dpon po des tshags par mar klog ste bod kyi skor 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i nang shes kyi yod pa red/ 'dzam gling nang bod don 'di byas pa red/ ga byas pa red/ zer ba sogs gsungs kyi red/ dgong mor bzo grwa'i khang pa chen po de'i nang nyan mkhan tag tag khengs bsdad yod pa red/ ngas gnas tshul de khyordo bod skad thog nas bshad/ mtshams mtshams la dgong mo'i chu lho'i bcu gcig bar du 'bo ra gyi sku da pa red/ skad bsgyur lhag bsam rnam dag gis byed kyi yod pa red/‘‘khyod tshos nga'i skad go yi 'dug gam/’’ ces dris dus/ khong tshos/‘‘go gi 'dug go gi 'dug’’ zer mod tshig kha shas go gi yod pa ma red/nga'i skad kyi nang am skad 'dres song ba red/ de ltar skad bsgyur bya mi dgos so gcig kyang yod pa ma red/ gsang spyod la 'gro ba dang sman khang la 'gro ba/ bza

zha ra yin yang / phan thogs yod/ 65grwa la las ka bya rgyu min zer ba lta bu sogs mang po yod/yang nyin gcig nga lho'i bzo grwa'i mi mang tshang ma thogis 'du 'tshogis pa red/der mi re re la nga tsos skad cha dris pa red/ de yang /‘8khyed rang gis las ka ci zhig byed kyi yin/’’ sogs kyi sdu ba de tsho red/mi mang gis skad cha bshad don la/‘‘nga thosi thag 'thag pa'i las ka byed kyi min/ nga snus mgar ba'i las ka byed kyi min/ grwa pa tshos las ka de rigs byed rung gi ma red/ de las ngas gnam gru'i las ka byed kyi yin/ me sgyogs rgyag pa'i las ka slob sbyong byed kyi yin/ khrims dang 'brel ba'i las ka byed kyi yin/’’ zhes bsam 'char bshad pa red/ khrims kyi las ka byed pa'i tho blangs tshe/ mi tshang mas 'tshang kha byed kyi yod/mo ṭa sbyong chog gi red zer dus yang mi tshang mas tho 'god gi yod pa red/ de la rgya gar gyi 'brel yod dpon po des ga re bzhad pa red zer na/‘‘gnam gru bzo ba'i las ka byed pa de'i skor la/ khyed rang tso skas 'dzegs 'dabs nas 'dzegs thengs gcig gis lam seng skas 'dzegs rtse la snyobs kyi ma red/ skas 'dzegs kyi skas rim rim pa bzhin phyin te skas mgo la slebs kyi red/ de yin dus/ khyed tshos gnam gru'i las ka byas na'ang red/ mo ṭa'i las ka yin na'ang red/ me sgyogs kyi las ka yin na'ang red/ gang ltar yang de tsho tshang ma lcags bzo ba'i las ka red/ lcags bakhro'i las ka ma byas pa yin na/ las ka byed rgyu gang yang yod ma red/ da khyed rang thos mgar ba'i las ka byed kyi min

zhes bshad kyi yod pa red/ de ltar byas na khyed rang lho'i skad cha la rgyu mtshan yod pa ma red/’’ ces 'grel bshad brgyab pa red/ mtha' ma der bod rigs kha shas kyis lham bzo ba'i las ka byas pa dang / yang kha shas kyis mgar ba byas pa red/

7gang thag mchag 'a/ gathagang bsgyar/༄ ༄1lngacaXlo'i phyi swo ca/7༷ḍi+od yul ོ༷gas so so'i gsar 'gyuro me long du 'khad pa ltar na/phya zla tsu sa 2rngunyan 7gang sa mchag ḍal har du zhabs sor 'khod cing /de ni der yod btsan byol bod mi'i 'go 'doms pa rgya gar gyi dpon rigs khag nas gdan zhu gnang ba zhig red/7gong sa mchog gis btsan ṭī+o+osna ༵ṭ+wāṃ ldu~X ༵sna bye ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃr+sho ḍizlo/ kha/ ṭ+wāṃzhi ṭ+wāṃ bumi 'a tram̐/ ༵ kā dī ོ༵ba/ da~X kā ṭ+wāṃ~X bshad ༷nang ba red/gsung bshas+t+ri khag gnyi+os yod pa ༷ bod sduzhung phyi dri+ol ༵sa khyangs kyas dpar bskrun gan+d+rang ba' ༷༷༷ /ba phyaspras bsnabs kya nang 'khad 'dugargya gar dbus gzhung ga skyob gas sa pa' drung che sku zhabs gup+ta dang /ḍa la ha'o se'i skyob gso tsogs pa'i drung gtso sku zhabs e se pi li khā na /bzo las khang gi dbu 'doms sku zhabs go bi kri khi ṇa bcas ni skabs 'di'i 'brel yod rgya gar gyi las sne ba gal chen zhigo tu snang /7gong sa mchog gis lag shes bzo las kyi n+d+rage rgan las byed dang bcasdu par dmigs bsal mjal kha gnang thoga'aga' zhag la gnas tshul bka' 'dra

68 a khu pad ma/gnang / phyi zla 7 tshes 1 nyin 7gong sa mchog gis mi mang la sgrol dkar tshe dbang dang / de rjes bka' slob gnang / nyin 'di dag gi gnas tshul gong gsal gsar shog tu zhib gsal 'khod pa las mdor bsdus thig 'dir drangs na/ sgrol dkar tshe dbang gnang skabs 'di skabs bod mi 1༷༷༷ skor yod/ tshang mas mig nas mchi ma lhal ljug gtong ba dang / nye skor rgya gar ba mang po'ang rgyang nas 7gong sa mchog la thal mo sbyar te zhal mjal gus 'dud kyis tshang ma 'jam thing nger bka' slob zhu bzhin 'dug skabs 'gar 7gong sa mchog kyang sbyan chab sil nye'i snang tshul byung song / zhes dang / 7gong sa mchog da lam ḍa la ha'o ser 'khyugs phebs la rgya gar dpon phyogs nas gzengs bstod phebs sgrig gzab cing rgyas pa zhus 'dug dber na/ bka' chos gnang yul bod mi'i lag shes thon rdzas 'grems ston gyi spang thang der pan jab yul lugs kyi bya g.yab tshon khra lcags ri yol skor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gang sar glog gzhu shel dreng brgya phrag mang po bstar bsgrigs dang / glog gzhu shel tog snus sgrigs kyi me tog 'dra ba/ glog gzhu shel tog tshos tshogs kyi dbyin yig wel kam dga' bsu'i tshig brjod can/bzhugs khri khri lcog dang bcas gsar bzhengs rgyan sbros ldan pa/ rgyang bsgrags 'khor lo gsar btsugs/ bzo las khang nas gsar btags kha gdan sna ceṇ+ḍakas bting pa sogs gra sgrig phun sum thogis pa zhus 'dug ces 'khod/ rtsom pa pos bris shing btus pa'i mchan/nyin gcig nga tsho'i bzo grwa'i 'gan 'dzin go bi kri ṣa ṇa yis nga la bshad don/
